izzyondroid:com.eddyizm.degoogled.tempus.name: Tempus
izzyondroid:com.eddyizm.degoogled.tempus.summary: An open-source and privacy focused music client for Subsonic
izzyondroid:com.eddyizm.degoogled.tempus.description:
Tempus is an open-source, privacy focused and lightweight music client for Subsonic, designed and built natively for Android. It provides a seamless and intuitive music streaming experience, allowing you to access and play your Subsonic music library directly from your Android device.
Features
 Subsonic Integration: Tempus seamlessly integrates with your Subsonic server, providing you with easy access to your entire music collection on the go.
 Sleek and Intuitive UI: Enjoy a clean and user-friendly interface designed to enhance your music listening experience, tailored to your preferences and listening history.
 Browse and Search: Easily navigate through your music library using various browsing and searching options, including artists, albums, genres, playlists, decades and more.
 Streaming and Offline Mode: Stream music directly from your Subsonic server. Offline mode is currently under active development and may have limitations when using multiple servers.
 Playlist Management: Create, edit, and manage playlists to curate your perfect music collection.
 Gapless Playback: Experience uninterrupted playback with gapless listening mode.
 ReplayGain: Volume normalization, preamp offset and clipping prevention if your metadata provide the information.
 Scrobbling Integration: Optionally integrate Tempus with Last.fm or Listenbrainz.org to scrobble your played tracks, gather music insights, and further personalize your music recommendations, if supported by your Subsonic server.
 Podcasts: If your Subsonic server supports it, listen to podcasts directly within Tempus, expanding your audio entertainment options.
 Radio: Tempus can now also search and save Internet radio stations on local device even without a backend subsonic api support.
 Instant Mix: Full refactor of instant mix function which leverages subsonics similarSongs2 by artist/album and similarSongs endpoints to server a larger play queue more reliably.
 Transcoding Support: Activate transcoding of tracks on your Subsonic server, allowing you to set a transcoding profile for optimized streaming directly from the app. This feature requires support from your Subsonic server.
 Multiple Libraries: Tempus handles multi-library setups gracefully. They are displayed as Library folders.
 Equalizer: Option to use built-in or third-party equalizer.
 Widget: New widget to keeping the basic controls on your screen at all times.
 Supports Lightweight Media Server (LMS), Navidrome, Gonic, NextCloud Music, Ampache, AirSonic Advanced, and other servers that support OpenSubSonic API
 Available in 14 languages: Currently in Basque, Catalan, Chinese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latam) and Turkish
 Chromecast/Android Auto Not Supported: These features require google libraries and are only available in the github apk.

Reef: Stay Focused and Boost Productivity
 Reef is your ultimate productivity companion, designed to help you stay focused, manage screentime, and minimize distractions. Whether you’re working, studying, or simply want to disconnect from unnecessary distractions, Reef empowers you to take control of your time and focus on what matters.
 Note: We use Accessibility Service to know when you are using unproductive apps and close them automatically. No information leaves your device, nor is it distributed to any third parties.
 Key Features: 
 Focus Mode: Enter focus mode to pause distracting apps and stay productive. Once your focus session is over, all apps resume automatically, letting you get back to them without interruption.
 Routine Scheduling: Set up daily or weekly routines to automatically activate focus mode during specific times. Whether it’s work hours, study sessions, or personal time, Reef adapts to your schedule.
 App Whitelist: Customize your focus sessions by whitelisting essential apps that you still need access to, even during focus mode. Keep important tools available while pausing distractions.
 App Usage Limits: Set daily limits for apps and receive reminders when you’re nearing your limit. Manage how much time you spend on social media, games, or any other apps that distract you.
 Pause & Resume: With a single tap, pause apps during focus mode and resume them effortlessly when you’re done. This simple control helps you manage distractions with ease.
 Digital Well-being: Reef helps improve your digital well-being by promoting healthy app usage habits. Cut down on screen time and reclaim your focus to achieve your goals.
 Personalized Experience: Tailor your focus settings to your lifestyle. Whether you want to focus for a few minutes or a few hours, Reef adapts to your needs.
 Why Choose Reef? 
 In a world filled with distractions, Reef helps you regain control over your time and attention. Whether you’re studying, working, or just need a break from constant notifications, Reef is the perfect tool to boost your productivity and maintain a healthy balance between your digital life and your real-world responsibilities.
 Take control of your time, eliminate distractions, and achieve more with Reef!

fdroid:com.prof18.feedflow.name: FeedFlow - RSS Feed Reader
fdroid:com.prof18.feedflow.summary: Minimal RSS reader with offline reading, reader mode & flexible sync options.
fdroid:com.prof18.feedflow.description:
FeedFlow is a minimal RSS reader for people who want a clean, chronological timeline — no algorithms, no clutter, no noise. Just your feeds, in order.
Whether you follow news sites, blogs, or YouTube channels via RSS, FeedFlow gives you a fast, distraction-free way to keep up with everything you care about.
Read Articles Your Way
- Open articles in your default browser, or pick a dedicated browser for reading sessions.
- Use Reader Mode for a distraction-free article view with adjustable text size and spacing.
- Prefetch and cache full article content for offline reading — read articles anywhere, even without an internet connection.
- View the original web page or switch to a clean, readable format — the choice is yours.
Sync Feeds Across All Your Devices
- Keep everything local, or sync feeds across devices with multiple backends.
- Cloud storage sync with Dropbox or Google Drive.
- Self-hosted and server sync with FreshRSS, Miniflux, Feedbin, or BazQux.
- Your feeds, read status, and bookmarks stay in sync across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Switch between phone, tablet, and desktop without losing your place.
Stay Organized with Feeds and Categories
- Import and export feeds with OPML — migrate from any other RSS reader or news reader in minutes.
- Block noisy keywords to filter out unwanted content from your feed.
- Organize RSS feeds into categories and bookmark articles to read later.
- Search across all your feeds and articles to quickly find the content you need.
A News Reading Experience You Control
- Dark mode, light mode, and OLED black theme for comfortable reading day and night.
- Background refresh keeps your feed list up to date with new articles and posts.
Built for RSS, Atom, and the Open Web
- Full support for RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0, and Atom feed formats.
- Subscribe to blogs, news sites, YouTube channels, and more.
- No account required — add feeds directly by URL or browse curated feed suggestions to get started.
- OPML import and export means you're never locked in to any single app.
Perfect For
- News enthusiasts who want a chronological feed without algorithmic recommendations.
- Blog readers who want all their favorite sites in one clean timeline.
- Self-hosted enthusiasts running FreshRSS, Miniflux, or similar services.
- Anyone switching from another feed reader — OPML import makes migration simple.
Why FeedFlow?
- No algorithmic feed — your timeline is always chronological.
- Open source with an active community and regular updates.
- Available on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Translated into 25+ languages by contributors worldwide.
Take back control of your news and reading — download FeedFlow today.

fdroid:dev.calyptra.pappus.name: Pappus Travel Planner
fdroid:dev.calyptra.pappus.summary: From the plan to the settle-up — everything your trips involve
fdroid:dev.calyptra.pappus.description:
Plan a trip day by day — where you go, how you get there, and what it costs, broken down by category and by person — and keep the whole database in one portable SQLite file that belongs to you. No account, no server, nothing uploaded. The app works with the network switched off; the exceptions are an optional connection search that looks up real timetables and writes the answer into your local plan, and the map, whose background tiles are fetched while you look at them.
You can plan all kinds of trips: an afternoon out, the daily commute, and two weeks abroad are planned the same way, and differ only in their dates.
 Features 
• Trips, organized the way you file them — dates, notes, participants, an accent color, and tags you invent yourself. Search, filter, and sort the overview, or switch it to a month calendar.
• Routines — keep a commute or a weekly ride as a dateless template and stamp it out onto any day, before or after the fact.
• A day-by-day itinerary of places and transport legs, with optional times, grouping for a shared ticket, and drag-to-reorder.
• Alternatives — plan different ways a day could go and pick one later; only the chosen option counts toward the trip's money.
• Planned versus actual times, with a green or red +/− on each end, and a "you are here" mark on today's plan.
• Real connections — search an open routing service (Transitous) covering public transport, long-distance trains, buses, and more from operators around the world, compare the results, import one as that day's legs, and refresh its live times later.
• A map — a trip's places and legs on an OpenStreetMap background, with the entry that is under way marked as the timeline marks it. Record a track from the map, or import a GPX file, and the map draws the line you actually followed instead of the straight one.
• Photos and files on the plan — attach a photograph or a document to an entry, to a group, or to the trip itself. They live inside the database, so a copy of that one file is a copy of everything. A photo carrying a position shows up on the map, and one of them can be the cover on the trip's overview card.
• Costs in as many currencies as you like — attached to a place, a leg, a whole shared ticket, or the trip, with your own categories and your own exchange rates.
• Countries you have been to — the world drawn from bundled outlines, counted from your trips or entered manually.
• Statistics — spending by category and by person, and how you actually traveled: legs and time per transport mode, planned against what really happened.
• Settle-up — paid versus fair share, a minimal set of payments to square up, and settlements you can book back once they are paid.
• Checklists per trip, movable and copyable to the next one.
• Share and export — a lossless .tpt bundle for another user of the app (attachments included), a printable PDF with the sections you tick, or an .ics file for whatever calendar you already use.
• An Android home-screen widget — your current or next trip, a countdown, and today's plan with the same delay marks the timeline uses; tapping a row opens that entry.
• English, German, and Chinese, and a light / dark / system theme.
Free and open software under the GPL-3.0-or-later. The same code base also runs on Linux, Windows, macOS, the web, and iOS.

flathub:app.shizumu.Shizumu.name: Shizumu
flathub:app.shizumu.Shizumu.summary: A private writing app to think in
flathub:app.shizumu.Shizumu.description:
Shizumu is a private writing app. Open it and start the sentence: there is nothing to structure
 first, and nowhere to file it. You write to think, you pin what matters, and you trail what continues.
 The volume of writing is not the artifact; what you pin is. Every page starts empty, so the first
 sentence is the first thing that happens.
 Pages flow into a daily memory you can scroll back through and search by content. Pins lift
 the lines that matter out of the daily stream: checklists, references, anything you want close
 at hand. Trails group writing that belongs together (a project, a book, an ongoing thread of thought)
 without forcing you to design a structure first, and the first time you put a page on a trail,
 the pins you already kept there come back onto the page. A trail can be a run of dated pages, or
 a continuous trail: one living document for a thread that should keep growing, such as a book,
 with a marker for each day you wrote in it. That is the one intentional exception, and you choose
 it.
 The editor is keyboard driven. Type / for a table, a chart, an outline or a block of code; type
 @ to reach a page, a pin or a trail. Ctrl+K opens the trail index, Ctrl+P pins from the cursor,
 Ctrl+F finds, and a shortcuts panel lists the rest.
 Local-first by design. Everything stays on your device, in a SQLite database you can open with
 any compatible tool. Sync is optional and end-to-end encrypted: your writing is sealed on your
 device before it leaves it, the keys are derived there and never leave, and the relay holds what
 it cannot read. Neither can we. Your writing remains yours.
 Shizumu fits the writer who keeps a daily log, the developer with one trail per project, the
 student capturing reading notes, and anyone who wants a private place to write to think without
 learning a system first.

flathub:cafe.avery.Delfin.name: Delfin
flathub:cafe.avery.Delfin.summary: Stream movies and TV shows from Jellyfin
flathub:cafe.avery.Delfin.description:
Delfin is a native client for the Jellyfin media server. It features a fast and clean
 interface to stream your media in an embedded MPV-based video player.
 Delfin currently supports streaming movies and TV shows from your library. The video
 player
 supports the Intro Skipper plugin for skipping intros automatically, and the Jellyscrub
 plugin
 to show thumbnails while scrubbing through videos.
 This is an early release, you may run into bugs or missing features. Delfin does not come
 with any media, you must connect to a Jellyfin server. Plugins must be installed and
 configured on your server to be available from Delfin.

flathub:com.simulide.simulide.name: SimulIDE
flathub:com.simulide.simulide.description:
SimulIDE is a simple real time electronic circuit simulator, intended for hobbyist or students to learn and experiment with analog and digital electronic circuits and microcontrollers. It supports PIC, AVR , Arduino and other MCUs and MPUs.
 Simulation speed is one of the most relevant characteristics of this simulator. It has been deeply optimized to achieve excellent speeds and low cpu usage.
 SimulIDE also features a code Editor and Debugger for Arduino, GcBasic, PIC asm, AVR asm and others. It is possible to write, compile and do basic debugging with breakpoints, watch registers and global variables.
 Features:
 Analog and Digital components
 Microcontrollers
 Code Editor
 Debugger
 Subcircuits
 DIP/Logic Symbols
 Circuit Animation
 Basic Shapes
 Oscilloscope
 Logic Analyzer
 Serial Port Connection
 Serial Monitor

ossia score is a sequencer for audio-visual artists, designed to enable the creation of interactive shows, museum installations, intermedia digital artworks, interactive music and more in an intuitive user interface.

flathub:net.sourceforge.DuneLegacy.name: Dune Legacy
flathub:net.sourceforge.DuneLegacy.description:
Lead one of three interplanetary houses, Atreides, Harkonnen or Ordos,
 in an attempt to harvest the largest amount of spice from the sand
 dunes. Exchange your spice stockpiles for credits through refinement
 and build an army capable of thwarting attempts of the other houses to
 stop your harvesting!
 Dune Legacy is an effort by a handful of developers to revitalize the
 first-ever real-time strategy game. The original game was the basis
 for the hugely successful Command and Conquer series, and the gameplay
 has been replicated an extended to a wide variety of storylines and
 series.
 NOTE: Original Dune 2 game files are needed.

flathub:net.sourceforge.qtpfsgui.Luminan.name: Luminance HDR
flathub:net.sourceforge.qtpfsgui.Luminan.description: Luminance HDR is an application for taking a set of pictures of the same scene with different exposure settings and creating a high dynamic range (HDR) image. It supports a range on input image formats, including JPEG, TIFF and RAW. It provides eleven tone mapping operators for converting the HDR back to a low dynamic range image (LDR). It can also rotate, crop, resize HDR images and apply projective transformations. HDR images can be created and tone mapped in batch and a tool is provided for copying EXIF data from/to a set of images.

flathub:org.diasurgical.DevilutionX.name: DevilutionX
flathub:org.diasurgical.DevilutionX.description:
DevilutionX is a source port of Diablo and Hellfire that strives to make it simple to run the game while providing engine improvements, bugfixes, and some optional quality of life features. This includes support for modern operating systems and higher resolutions, controller and touch control support, translations, stash, optional experience and enemy health bars, etc.
 Note: DevilutionX requires data files from original Diablo/Hellfire. By default, a demo version of Diablo is installed.
 To install the full version of Diablo, copy DIABDAT.MPQ from the CD or GOG-installation (or extract it from the GoG installer) to ~/.var/app/org.diasurgical.DevilutionX/data/diasurgical/devilution.
 To run the Diablo: Hellfire expansion you will need to also copy hellfire.mpq, hfmonk.mpq, hfmusic.mpq, hfvoice.mpq.

flathub:org.gnome.Hamster.name: Hamster
flathub:org.gnome.Hamster.description:
Hamster is time tracking for individuals. It helps you to keep track of how
 much time you have spent during the day on activities you choose to track.
 Whenever you change from doing one task to other, you change your current
 activity in Hamster. After a while you can see how many hours you have spent on
 what. Maybe print it out, or export to some suitable format, if time reporting
 is a request of your employer.
 Features:
 Fast and easy data entry with autocompletion of recent activities
 Flexible grouping with @categories and #tags
 Day, week, month or custom views with tallies by groups
 Generation of html reports (can be customized)
 Data export in text, xml and tsv formats

 The programming language is known for its powerful macro system which enables
 the creation of embedded and domain-specific languages, language constructs
 such as classes or modules, and separate dialects of Racket enable different
 semantics.
 DrRacket is a graphical environment for developing programs using the Racket programming languages.

The Latin glyphs are scaled to match the glyphs for Japanese kana and kanji, and their widths are adjusted to be exactly 667 units (two-thirds of an EM). fedora-packages:aftertheflood-sparks-fon.description: After the Flood Sparks is a font that allows for the combination of text and visual data to show an idea and evidence in one headline. This builds on the principle of Sparklines defined by Edward Tufte and makes them easier to use. Sparklines are currently available as plugins or javascript elements. By installing the Sparks font you can use them immediately without the need for custom code. Sparks data needs to be formatted as comma-separated values, with curly brackets at both ends of the set, e.g., {30,60,90}. You can also have numbers at the beginning and end of the set, which are useful for providing the start and end points, e.g., 123{30,60,90}456 – Sparks has numerals built in. This package provides the Bar family.

fedora-packages:ghc-http-media/ghc-http-.name: ghc-http-media
fedora-packages:ghc-http-media/ghc-http-.summary: Processing HTTP Content-Type and Accept headers
fedora-packages:ghc-http-media/ghc-http-.description: This library is intended to be a comprehensive solution to parsing and selecting quality-indexed values in HTTP headers. It is capable of parsing both media types and language parameters from the Accept and Content header families, and can be extended to match against other accept headers as well. Selecting the appropriate header value is achieved by comparing a list of server options against the quality-indexed values supplied by the client. In the following example, the Accept header is parsed and then matched against a list of server options to serve the appropriate media using 'mapAcceptMedia': > getHeader >>= maybe send406Error sendResourceWith . mapAcceptMedia > [ ("text/html", asHtml) > , ("application/json", asJson) > ] Similarly, the Content-Type header can be used to produce a parser for request bodies based on the given content type with 'mapContentMedia': > getContentType >>= maybe send415Error readRequestBodyWith . mapContentMedia > [ ("application/json", parseJson) > , ("text/plain", parseText) > ] The API is agnostic to your choice of server.

"Lens.Family.Clone" allows for first-class support of lenses and traversals for those who cannot support rank 2 polymorphism.

firefox-addons:3011567.name: Ketuvia: accessible YouTube captions
firefox-addons:3011567.summary: Replaces YouTube's word-by-word subtitles with readable, phrase-based (sentence-by-sentence) captions. Built for accessibility: set the font, size, color, opacity, position, width and number of lines, and keep your phrasing in picture-in-picture.
firefox-addons:3011567.description:
A customizable Firefox and Chrome extension made with Deaf people and those with sensory processing differences in mind.
YouTube shows its auto-generated subtitles one word at a time, each word appearing at the moment it is spoken. This goes directly against accessibility practice: for captions to be usable they must form sentences that can be scanned at a glance before they are fully uttered, so the viewer can return their eyes to the video after reading.
Ketuvia replaces that word-by-word closed captioning with line-by-line phrases, and lets you decide how they look:
 Font, size, color, opacity, bold and outline
 Number of lines (1, 2 or 3) and caption width
 Position anywhere on the video
 Background opacity, from none/transparent to fully opaque
It also carries your phrasing into Firefox's picture-in-picture pop-out, repairs the letter-by-letter captions used by some broadcast news channels, and can leave a channel's hand-written subtitles exactly as the author wrote them.
Useful if you are Deaf or hard of hearing, or if you have dyslexia, ADHD, an auditory processing difference, or you simply find word-by-word subtitles distracting.
Works on YouTube in Firefox, Firefox for Android, Chrome and other Chromium browsers. Zero data collection, account, tracking (privacy focused!).

bluejetty:00079303:ios.description:
LAnow is a new on demand shared-ride service. Book a ride through the LAnow smartphone app or by phone, meet your shuttle at your scheduled LAnow pick-up/drop-off point, and ride to your destination. Get out of your car and relax or go where existing bus service can’t take you. Pick-up/drop-off points are never more than a few blocks (1/4 mile) away. You can also meet us at the LAnow Rideshare Hub at the Palms Expo Station.
How does LAnow work?
LAnow is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the LAnow app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up and drop you off within a quarter mile of your requested origin and destination, never more than a few blocks away. Get out of your car and relax or go where existing bus service can’t take you.
How long will I wait?
- You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking. You can also track your vehicle in real time in the app.
Try this new on-demand transport app that is guaranteed to change the way that you think about traveling. We look forward to seeing you on your next journey. Just click, pay, go!
Love our app? Please rate us! Questions? Email us at lanow@ladottransit.com

■ Touch ID / Face ID 
 -need the related hardware support (iPhone 5s+)
■ Pattern Lock
 -security and ease

How does Chandler Flex work?

bluejetty:00168292:ios.description:
The Chandler Flex app makes it easier than ever to move around Chandler, AZ — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. 
How does Chandler Flex work?
- Chandler Flex is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. 
- Using the app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. 
- Now for the clever bit; our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making on-demand transportation easier than ever before!
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said.
Questions? Head to chandleraz.gov/flex or reach out at support-chandlerflex@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00065960:ios.name: DRAGON QUEST VI
bluejetty:00065960:ios.summary:
Dragon Quest VI: Realms of Revelation , the final instalment in the Zenithian trilogy, is now available on mobile devices!
Experience an epic adventure spanning two parallel worlds!
Recover the heroes’ long-lost memories, and bring the two
bluejetty:00065960:ios.description:
Dragon Quest VI: Realms of Revelation , the final instalment in the Zenithian trilogy, is now available on mobile devices!
Experience an epic adventure spanning two parallel worlds!
Recover the heroes’ long-lost memories, and bring the two worlds together!
Download it once, and there’s nothing else to buy, and nothing else to download! 
********************
◆Prologue
A young lad from the secluded village of Weaver’s Peak lives a peaceful life with his little sister. But all that is to change when the mountain spirit appears before him, prophesying that only he can save the world from being swallowed by darkness. And so he sets out on a grand adventure to learn the truth of his world, and that of the mysterious phantom realm that lies beneath...
This world-spanning saga can now be enjoyed in the palm of your hand!
◆Game Features
・Join forces with a band of individual adventurers!
Amass a following of faithful friends as you travel around the riven realms. From wandering warriors to amnesiac teens, a rich cast of characters will join you in your adventures, and help you to unlock the mysteries of your clouded world!
・Vocational Education
As you progress in the game, the hero and his party will gain access to Alltrades Abbey, where they can specialise in any of over sixteen vocations. Train your skills in your chosen vocation, and learn a multitude of spells and special abilities. After you have mastered an ability, you can still use it even if you change vocation!
・Converse Freely with your Fellow Party Members!
The party chat function allows you to converse freely with the cast of colourful characters who will accompany you on your adventure. So don’t hesitate to turn to them for advice and idle chit-chat whenever the urge assails you! 
・360-Degree Views
Rotate your viewpoint in towns and villages through a full 360 degrees to make sure you don’t miss a thing! 
・AI Battles 
Tired of giving orders? Your faithful companions can be instructed to fight automatically! Use the various tactics at your disposal to see off even the toughest enemies with ease! 
・The Casino
Once again, the casino makes a comeback! While away the hours trying your hand at the poker tables or testing your luck at the slot machines, and exchange the tokens you earn for all kinds of exciting items! If lady luck smiles on you, you might be rewarded with the rarest items of all!
・The Slimopolis
Unlike previous titles, where monsters could only be recruited during battle, Dragon Quest VI lets you recruit an army of lovely little slimes as you travel around the world! Once you’ve recruited a slimy friend or two, head to the Slimopolis to test their mettle in a series of arena battles, with fabulous prizes on offer for any slime tough enough to emerge victorious! Train up your slimes, and aim for the championship!
・Slippin’ Slime
The slime-sliding minigame introduced in the Nintendo DS version makes its welcome return! Brush the ice in front of your sliding slime to guide it past perilous pitfalls and obstinate obstacles. Perfect your polishing action to hit the target, and send your score through the roof!

bluejetty:00073872:ios.summary:
TidesPro is a fast, powerful, and easy-to-use app for tides and marine weather.
Get accurate tide predictions and marine weather throughout NOAA-covered waters — whether you’re fishing, hitting the beach, boating, kayaking, surfing, or pla
bluejetty:00073872:ios.description:
TidesPro is a fast, powerful, and easy-to-use app for tides and marine weather.
Get accurate tide predictions and marine weather throughout NOAA-covered waters — whether you’re fishing, hitting the beach, boating, kayaking, surfing, or planning a trip.
Beyond tides, get detailed marine conditions, NOAA marine forecasts, and buoy observations to plan for the future or react to changing conditions.
For anglers, TidesPro offers fishing time recommendations and daily fishing ratings. Tap ⋯ on the top right on several screens to access settings to show even more fishing info.
TidesPro also puts tides, marine weather, and fishing times on your wrist with a super fast Apple Watch app — plus widgets and complications for your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and watch face for quick access without ever opening the app.
In addition to all that, it’s super privacy conscious with no tracking, and available on all your Apple devices: iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac.
TOP FEATURES
• NOAA Tide Data: Tide heights & tide times including interactive tide charts, weekly & monthly tide tables, high tide times, low tide times, and a ton of visualization options
• Marine Weather: Wind, waves, swell, water temperature, and conditions for most locations
• Interactive Map: Explore tides, wind, waves, and water temperature with overlays for wind, radar, nautical charts, satellite imagery, underwater topography, and more
• Fishing Insights: Best times to fish, including solunar periods and a daily fishing rating (extras in ⋯ menu on several screens)
• Widgets: See tides, solunar predictions, waves, and wind at a glance for nearby or favorite stations — right on your Home or Lock Screen. (Premium)
• Apple Watch: See tides on your wrist in the app or on the watch face with complications, along with wind, waves, swell and conditions (Premium required for complications)
MORE FEATURES
• Local Tides: Grant location access, and quickly access current tides near you with the current height alongside quick tide charts, tide tables, a tide clock, sun & moon times, moon phases, and fishing times
• Favorite Stations: Conveniently track tides at locations you care about most
• Marine Weather Forecasts: Including wind, waves, swell, and conditions for most locations
• Sun & Moon: View sunrise, sunset, moon phases, major & minor solunars, nautical & civil dawn & dusk
• NOAA Marine Zone Forecasts for most locations (Premium)
• NOAA NDBC Buoy Observations for many locations (Observation types vary, and not all locations are near a buoy)
• Tide Marks: Track a reference level, such as a tide height where your boat or kayak can clear certain area
• Tide Alerts: Set a tide alert to receive timely high tide & low tide notifications for your chosen location (Premium)
• Live Activities: Track tides, sun, or moon events on your Lock Screen or Dynamic Island (Premium)
PRIVACY-FIRST
TidesPro respects your privacy: an identifier ONLY when you use Live Activities because it's required to push updates, and it's never used to track you. Feel free to check out TidesPro using the App Privacy Report on your device and compare against other apps.
PREMIUM
The free version shows ads for the Premium service and has some features locked. Premium has a 1 week free trial, so you can try it out.
NOTES
• Provides NOAA tide and current predictions in NOAA-covered waters which include the United States and much of the Caribbean, including California, Florida, Texas and all major coasts (East, West & Gulf), plus Hawaii & Alaska. Select non-NOAA stations; availability may change.
• Requires an internet connection. Tide data is cached from the internet for your favorite and recently viewed stations, so it’s available offline when you've accessed those stations recently. Weather data always requires an internet connection.
• TidesPro uses its own API backed by NOAA data for tides predictions
Terms: https://www.tidespro.com/about/termsofuse
Privacy: https://www.tidespro.com/about/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00182770:ios.description:
Welcome to the thrilling world of Mini Legend! Take on the best Mini 4WD, also known as "Mini Yonku" (ミニ四駆) in Japan, racers and customize, modify, and race your cars through elaborate tracks in this exciting mobile simulation game. 
With over 150 different cars and hundreds of performance parts to choose from, you can create the ultimate Mini 4WD slot car. Explore Story Mode, which features a single player RPG campaign with more than 250 unique levels and challenging boss battles. Unlock avatars to use in other modes and become the ultimate Mini 4WD champion.
Challenge real players in Online PVP Mode, and see how your customized Mini 4WD stacks up against the competition. Compete in special format races, weekly specialty races, and limited edition car races in Online Events. In Daily Time Attack Races, challenge yourself to beat the daily target time and test your skills on daily random tracks.
Join forces with friends in Team Mode, and create your own race team to compete in the team ranking. Communicate with ease using the team chat system.
If you're new to Mini 4WD, it's a miniature model within the 1/20 (1:20) to 1/48 (1:48) scale. Experience the excitement of 1/32 (1:32) scaled, AA battery-powered plastic model race cars without remote control. With direct-drive on all four wheels, horizontal side rollers guide the vehicle against the vertical walls of the un-banked track for steering, providing thrilling speeds up to 65 km/h (40 mph) on the track.
Download Mini Legend now and become the ultimate Mini 4WD champion! Visit our Facebook & Customer Service Page: MiniLegend4WD or email us at cs@twitchyfinger.com for more information. Don't miss out on the excitement – get Mini Legend today!

bluejetty:00127311:ios.description:
If you play The Forest or Sons of the Forest, this app is a must have.
Forest Map is an interactive The Forest map and Sons of the Forest map that shows you cave locations, collectibles, items, crafting recipes, and guides for both games — with The Forest 3 map on the way.
Whether you're a new or returning player, this app's got you covered: every item from the original Forest and its sequel, Sons of the Forest, so you can play more and search less.
INTERACTIVE MAPS
• 2,500+ hand-placed markers across The Peninsula and the Sons of the Forest island
• Full cave map layers — never get lost underground again
• Filter by locations, collectibles, items, wildlife, and more
• Instant search: type what you need and jump straight to it
TRACK YOUR WAY TO 100%
• Mark items as found right from the map
• Watch your completion grow with per-category progress counters
• Tap any category to jump to the next item you're missing
• Long-press to check off an entire category at once
DISCOVERY MODE & CUSTOM MARKERS
• Drop your own pins for bases, caches, and points of interest
• Discovery mode hides everything but your own markers for a spoiler-free playthrough
GUIDES & CRAFTING
• Step-by-step walkthroughs, including How to Beat The Forest
• Every crafting recipe with exact ingredients and quantities
• Growing guide library covering all three Forest games
WHAT SURVIVORS SAY
"Best game companion app I have ever used!" — 5 Stars
"All the items are easily findable. It saves a lot of time." — 5 Stars
"This is an awesome help for me and my friend." — 5 Stars
Forest Map Pro is available as an auto-renewing subscription (weekly, monthly, or annual) or a one-time lifetime purchase. All plans unlock the same full access. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
This is an unofficial fan-made companion app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Endnight Games Ltd.

Ứng dụng Lịch Vạn Niên 2026 - Lịch Việt giúp bạn tra cứu lịch vạn niên, lịch âm dương, lịch việt, lịch vạn sự, lịch âm và nhiều tính năng khác đang chờ bạn khám phá.
Các tính năng chính trong ứng dụng: 
• Lịch Ngày
- Xem lịch Âm, lịch Dương 
- Xem can, chi của giờ, ngày, tháng, năm 
- Xem giờ Hoàng đạo
- Hiển thị danh ngôn theo chủ đề và thay đổi theo ngày
- Xem thời tiết hiện tại, cả ngày và các ngày kế tiếp
- Giao diện đẹp
- Thay đổi ảnh nền
• Lịch tháng:
- Xem nhanh ngày Âm, Dương theo tháng, chi tiết từng ngày
• Ghi chú:
- Thêm và quản lý ghi chú
• Văn hoá Việt:
- Lịch sử Việt Nam
- Danh nhân Việt Nam
- Thơ ca Việt Nam
- Ca dao tục ngữ
- Phong tục , hát ru, đồng dao
- Văn khấn
- Ý nghĩa ngày lễ
- Lời chúc tết
- Phong tục ngày tết
- Cẩm nang ngày tết
• Khám phá:
* Tiện ích: 
 - Tử vi bói toán: Tử vi theo năm, xem sao giải hạn, tử vi trọn đời
 - Đổi ngày: Đổi ngày âm dương, đếm ngày xuôi ngược
 - La bàn phong thuỷ
 - Xông đất
 - Các nội dung khác như: Danh nhân thế giới, danh ngôn cuộc sống, mẹo vặt hàng ngày, truyện cười, truyện cổ tích Việt Nam cũng như thế giới
 - Lịch Vạn Sự
 - Lịch âm
 - Lịch âm dương
 - Lịch Việt
 - Lịch Vạn Niên
* Cấu hình
Tải ngay và trải nghiệm tiện ích nhất ứng dụng Lịch vạn niên 2026 hiện có trên App Store.
Chú ý: Mọi thông tin trong ứng dụng chỉ mang tính chất tham khảo

$0.99 per month (VIP 1 month)

bluejetty:00158577:ios.summary: هــو نظــام متكامــل مزيــج مــن نظــم إدارة معلومــات الطلبــة مــع أنظمــة التعليــم الالكترونية الهــدف منــه هــو التعامــل مــع كل المعلومات الشــخصية للطلبــة بالإضافــة الى معلومــات عــن الجامعــة، الكــورس الــدراسي، معلومــات عــن
bluejetty:00158577:ios.description:
هــو نظــام متكامــل مزيــج مــن نظــم إدارة معلومــات الطلبــة مــع أنظمــة التعليــم الالكترونية الهــدف منــه هــو التعامــل مــع كل المعلومات الشــخصية للطلبــة بالإضافــة الى معلومــات عــن الجامعــة، الكــورس الــدراسي، معلومــات عــن كل دفعــة دراســية، 
المصـادر التعليميـة، التقاريـر الاكاديميـة، فضلا عـن الجـزء الخـاص بالتعليـم الالكـتروني الـذي يتخصـص بأجـراء عمليـة التواصـل بـين الأسـتاذ وطلبتـه مـن خـلال ارسـال المحـاضرات الالكترونيـة واسـتلام التقاريـر، الاختبـارات الالكترونيــة..... وغيرهــا مــن الفعاليــات الأخــرى.
حيـث انـه يقـوم بجمـع كل المعلومـات الدراسـية المتعلقـة بطلبـة الجامعـة في الكـورس الـدراسي وتفاصيـل امتحاناتهـم، علمـا بـان جميـع المعلومـات المذكـورة اعـلاه سـتكون متاحـة لـكل مـن الطلبـة واوليـاء امورهـم اضافــة الى انهــا متاحــة لــكل مــن الــكادر الإداري والتدريــسي عــى حــد ســواء.
ان هــذا النظــام يســهل مــن اكتشـاف كل الفعاليـات والمتغـيرات الاكاديميـة التــي تحـدث في الجامعــة مـن عمليـات التغييـر التــي تحــدث في درجــات الطلبــة وحالاتهــم، واعطــاء التقاريــر المختلفــة التــي توضــح تلــك التغيــيرات مــع امكانيــة اطلاع اوليــاء امــور الطلبــة عــى الحالــة الدراســية لأبنائهــم مــن خــلال ارســال اشــعارات لهــم عــن طريــق الشــبكة الدوليــة (بواســطة الإيميل)

bluejetty:00078670:ios.summary: Stop food waste, save money, and keep your kitchen organized with Grocery AI. Know what’s in your pantry, fridge, and freezer, get expiry alerts, plan meals around what you already have, and shop before you run out. Available on iPhone, iPa
bluejetty:00078670:ios.description:
Stop food waste, save money, and keep your kitchen organized with Grocery AI. Know what’s in your pantry, fridge, and freezer, get expiry alerts, plan meals around what you already have, and shop before you run out. Available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Home Screen widgets, and now fully optimized for iPhone Duo.
=== REDUCE FOOD WASTE & STAY STOCKED
◆ Track groceries by quantity or percentage left, so you always know what you have.
◆ Organize pantry, fridge, freezer, and other storage locations with custom inventory areas.
◆ Add expiry dates, photos, barcodes, notes, and multipack sizes for better accuracy.
◆ Get alerts for low stock, out-of-stock, expiring soon, and expired items.
◆ Search your whole pantry and filter by expired, expiring soon, low, or empty items.
◆ Automatically update inventory as items are purchased, used, or consumed.
◆ Import inventory from receipts, notes, pantry photos, CSV files, and Excel spreadsheets.
=== SMART SHOPPING LISTS
◆ Create color-coded shopping lists for different stores, trips, or occasions.
◆ Add items fast by search, barcode, Voice Add, Siri, receipt, note, or photo import, or recipe ingredients.
◆ Scan a barcode to see the product, photo, retailer prices, and if it’s already on a list (U.S.).
◆ Search across all your lists by item, category, sub-category, or #tag.
◆ Organize items with quantity, unit, size, brand, notes, photos, barcode, priority, and favorites.
◆ Sort by aisle, category, favorites, priority, checked status, or Smart AI Sorting.
◆ Compare prices across retailers and track coupon savings, taxes, and totals.
◆ Add expiry dates while you shop so they carry into your pantry at checkout.
◆ Save receipts to checkout history for returns, bookkeeping, and price tracking.
◆ Keep rewards cards linked to your list for faster checkout.
◆ Bulk edit items to move, copy, tag, recategorize, or update multiple items at once.
=== RECIPES & MEAL PLANNING
◆ Save and organize recipes in folders so meal ideas are always easy to find.
◆ Import recipes from links, Safari, Instagram, TikTok, cookbook pages, or a photo of any dish.
◆ Create recipes from a dish name or your ingredients, with a photo of the finished dish.
◆ Chef AI suggests meals from the pantry items you choose, plus substitutions and recipe help.
◆ See which ingredients you have and update pantry stock right from a recipe.
◆ Add recipe ingredients to one or more shopping lists with scaled quantities.
◆ Plan your week with recipes or quick meals, built around what needs using soon.
◆ Mark meals as eaten to keep inventory honest and up to date.
◆ Email or print your meal plan for the family or the fridge.
=== AI TOOLS THAT SAVE TIME
◆ Voice Add 2.0 turns natural speech into grocery items with quantities, sizes, brands, units, and notes.
◆ AI sorts and organizes imported items, so you spend less time cleaning up.
◆ Scan a dish photo for an estimated nutrition card.
=== SIRI, APPLE WATCH, WIDGETS & SYNC
◆ Ask Siri to add items, read, check off, or open a list, or make custom phrases in Shortcuts.
◆ Use Apple Watch to view lists, check off items, and glance at inventory alerts.
◆ Add Home Screen widgets for lists, inventory, recipes, and meal plans, with interactive check-off on supported iOS versions.
◆ Sync lists, inventory, recipes, and meal plans across devices with one Grocery AI account.
=== FULLY OPTIMIZED FOR IPHONE DUO
◆ Use the outer screen on the go, then unfold to see your pantry, lists, and recipes side by side.
◆ Fold, unfold, or rotate anytime. The layout adapts instantly and keeps your place.
◆ Tabletop cooking shows a supported recipe’s video above the steps.
Some advanced AI, sync, import, and sharing features may require Premium. Subscription options may include monthly or yearly billing, and auto-renewal can be managed in your Apple ID account settings.
Terms Of Use: https://www.groceryai.com/termsofservice
Privacy Policy: https://www.groceryai.com/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00129677:ios.description:
Your store in the palm of your hand and in real time.
Nex is a mobile sales application that makes it easy to manage your store!
With it, you have access to features such as:
* POS: Point of Sale.
* Sales Control.
* Registration and Product Control.
* Registration and Customer Control.
* Category Management.
Simplify your day-to-day business with an app that allows you to manage your business in an uncomplicated way and make sales in a matter of minutes, anywhere and anytime!
Learn more about how our resources can help you in your routine:
* POS: Point of Sale
Make your online sales or offline sales in your point of sale app! Open the Nex application, access our POS, launch your sales quickly and that's it! It has never been so easy to sell online, on the street, at home, in your store or wherever you are.
* Control of orders and Registration of purchase and sale
Carry out sales quickly by registering the payment method, possible discounts, notes and share the sales receipt instantly from your cell phone!
* Registration and Product Control
Register your store products in the app! Imagine being able to use this mobility with the registration of the products on your cell phone without having the computer nearby: now it's much more practical.
In the product registration you can include information such as:
- Description.
- Photo of the product from the gallery or registered in the app itself.
- Cost and sale price.
- Cost price.
- Code (manual or automatic using barcode reader).
- Unit of measurement.
- Category.
* Registration and Customer Control
Register your customers in the management app in seconds. Customer registration is a great marketing tool. The more information, the better you serve each customer, increasing the chances of loyalty.
Offer personalized service!
In the customer register you will be able to register:
- Name.
- Phone.
- Email.
- Address.
- Sales.
* Integration with a complete computer management system
Nex for the computer is a business management system that will make your store's routine easier. With it you can control your stock, record your sales, control the cash register, create quotations, print receipts and labels, register customers, products, suppliers, control accounts payable and much more!
Nex: created by those who understand commerce.

bluejetty:00175804:ios.description:
هذا التطبيق
هو تطبيق أذكار شامل، يحتاجه كل مسلم يوميا، لما فيه من الأذكار الشاملة والكنوز العظيمة، وهو ثمرة جهود أكثر من عام من العمل المتواصل في التصميم والتنفيذ والبرمجة والتدقيق والمراجعة والتصحيح، فتم بفضل الله تعالى إنجاز تطبيق "فاذكروني أذكركم"، الذي يمتاز بمميزات فريدة عديدة، منها: 
1) الأذكار في هذا التطبيق هي من القرآن الكريم والسنة الصحيحة، وتمت مراجعتها بدقة من قبل طلبة العلم والشيخ د. عثمان الخميس.
2) الخط الواضح الكبير، مع خاصية القراءة الليلية.
3) سهولة الاستعمال والتصفح، حيث يمكن الوصول إلى الذكر المطلوب من خلال العناوين الرئيسية الواضحة، مثل: أذكار الصباح، أذكار المساء، أذكار النوم، أذكار التقلب ليلا، أذكار الاستيقاظ من النوم، كنوز الجنة، الأذكار بعد الصلاة، الرقية الشرعية، الدعاء، الدعاء للميت. 
4) توجد خاصية الاستماع لقراءة صوتية مميزة لكل ذكر، لمن يرغب بمعرفة النطق الصحيح لذلك الذكر.
5) يوجد زر للمشاركة بإرسال الأذكار عبر وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، لتعميم الفائدة، ونشر السنة، ومضاعفة الأجور بإذن الله تعالى. 
6) توجد خاصية ضبط المنبهات لأوقات الصلوات وأوقات الأذكار. 
وغير ذلك من المميزات التي بين يديك، والتي ستأتي في التحديثات اللاحقة بإذن الله تعالى.

bluejetty:00171993:ios.description:
The Israel of God (IOG) is a bible study class. Our mission is to teach the uncut word of God from Genesis to Revelations according to the prophets (Old Testament) and the apostles (New Testament). We observe the Lord’s Sabbath Day, the Lord’s Feast Days (as outlined in Leviticus 23), and the Lord’s Dietary Law (as outlined in Leviticus 11). We believe the testimony of Jesus Christ and teach and observe the Royal Law, which are the Ten Commandments. 
Join us as we teach lessons that will provide a rich and deeper understanding of your Bible and illustrate examples of biblical application.
Subscribe to IOG Bible TV for access to:
- A database of Sabbath Day lessons taught by subject and title
- Unlimited streaming anytime, anywhere
- Lessons that can be a “gift” to a loved one
- Text message notifications when new lessons are available
Download the IOG Bible TV app and begin your journey to understanding your bible and God’s plan of salvation for all nations!
Start your subscription today!
To access all features and content you can subscribe to IOG Bible TV on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://ioglessons.vhx.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://ioglessons.vhx.tv/privacy

Fido connects Canadians through its amazingly fast LTE network, delivering seamless connectivity and lightning-fast speeds for all your needs. Get the Fido My Account app so you can manage your account and services, it’s never been easier. Track your data usage with Data Bytes™, set wireless alerts, make secure payments, and access your account safely anytime, anywhere.
Stay on top of your plan and usage
Quickly check your plan details, upgrade options and account balance. Compare rates, review other plans and select add-ons to customize your services. You can also upgrade your device or check eligibility directly in the app.
Track data usage and set alerts
Keep an eye on your data usage with real-time tracking and set up notifications to avoid going over your data. Staying within your plan and budget has never been simpler.
Manage SIM and eSIM
• Activate, swap or manage your SIM or eSIM directly in the app. 
• Manage your family’s mobile lines all in one place to keep everyone connected.
24/7 support anytime you need it
• Get support whenever you need it with our robust selection of support articles.
• Chat with our virtual assistant, always ready to help.
Data Bytes™ – 5 Extra Hours of Data
• Get 5 extra hours of data each month on select Fido Pulse™ plans! 
• Activate 1 free hour of data, 5 times a month, with a simple shake of your phone in the Fido My Account app. 
• Stream, share and surf worry-free—no WiFi needed!
Travelling
• If you’re travelling out of the country or province you can check travel options and features on your plan
• Choose when to hold or suspend your service for a short while, if you’re going out of town.
Exclusive Rogers Bank offers – available for Fido customers too
• Discover special offers from Rogers Bank directly through the app. 
• Earn unlimited cash-back rewards with Rogers Red Mastercard, on all your purchases, redeemable anywhere Mastercard is accepted. Enjoy the benefits of no annual fee and get rewarded for everyday spending.
Customize add-ons and services
• Choose the add-ons you need, like extra data, long distance and voicemail. 
• Change your number or add roaming options to match your plans.
Track orders and stay updated
• Track your orders in real-time
• Stay informed with our “What’s New” section to learn about the latest app features.
• Secondary users can use the “guest login” with their mobile number to view usage and manage their line.
Why choose the Fido MyAccount app?
• Manage account and services: pay bills, check mobile data usage and set wireless data alerts
• Secure login: safe and easy access to your account
• Plan and add-ons: check plans, upgrade options, and customize add-ons
• Device upgrades: upgrade your device or check eligibility
• SIM/eSIM: activate or swap your SIM or eSIM seamlessly in the app
• 24/7 support: get help anytime with our virtual assistant
• Travel options: manage roaming and travel settings on the go
• Exclusive Rogers Bank offers

bluejetty:00027766:ios.description:
Discover the next level of stair construction with the RedX Stair App, now fully enhanced with stunning 3D capabilities. This app is your essential companion for efficient and precise stair measurement and visualization. Featuring a wide selection of calculators for every type of stair configuration including Straight Stairs , L-Shaped Stairs, U-Shaped Stairs, Spiral Stairs, Winder Stairs, Corner Deck Stairs and more, it effortlessly simplifies the most complex stair calculations. Whether you're working in CM, MM, Feet, or Inches, this app ensures versatile and accurate measurements for professionals and DIY enthusiasts alike.
Key Upgrades and Features:
Advanced 3D visualization for all stair types, offering a dynamic and immersive design experience
Comprehensive suite of calculators for Straight, L, U, Spiral Stairs, Winders, and more, accommodating any project requirement
Interactive, to-scale stair plans with precise measurements, enhancing design accuracy and efficiency
Multifaceted measurement support in CM, MM, Feet, and Inches for global applicability
Efficient project management options: Print, Share, Save to Photos, or Store designs in-app for future reference
Detailed plans and measurements for common stair builds, including stringer details for unparalleled clarity
Specialized tools for designing Spiral, Curved, and Winder stairs with customizable specifications
Exclusive Features for Enhanced Design:
Enter key details like Total Rise, Stringer, and Tread information to instantly generate detailed, to-scale stair plans
Customize your stair designs with adjustable Stair Angles, Step Numbers, and more for perfect fit and function
For Spiral and Curved Stairs, specify Total Rise, Rotation, and Radius to receive plans with Inner and Outer Stringer measurements
Unique Winder Stairs feature for detailed planning of each tread, ensuring precise execution of complex designs
Specialized calculators for Hip Stringers and Stairs with Landings, offering comprehensive design solutions
The RedX Stair App is the ultimate tool for transforming your stair design process with the power of 3D visualization. Download now to experience unparalleled precision and creativity in stair design. Stay ahead with continuous updates and new features, elevating your design capabilities to new heights.
----------

https://www.redxapps.com/terms-of-service
In-app purchases available for premium features. Subscription options include a monthly or yearly Stairs App Pro Subscription, with payment charged to your iTunes account and easy management of auto-renewal settings in the App Store. Pricing details and subscription terms available within the app.

bluejetty:00086825:ios.description:
With e-Boks you can access your mail digitally and securely from both companies and public authorities, anywhere and anytime. 
Our app provides you with a range of options to organize your mail. But e-Boks is much more than just a digital mailbox:
- Sign documents digitally. The documents are easily signed using MitID and saved in e-Boks.
- Pay bills. Pay your bills directly in e-Boks. Pay with credit card or Betalingsservice. 
- e-Boks supports a multi-level folder structure unlike any other digital mailboxes out there, allowing you to organize your mail in a perfect tree structure.
- Mail management at your fingertips. Just swipe right to mark a message as read, or swipe left to archive.
- Read and manage mail that others have given you access to.
- Upload important personal documents. e-Boks is like an online bank vault, which allows you to store everything from mortgage deeds and birth certificates to photographs of your valuables for insurance claims.
We are also introducing e-Boks Plus. Here you can access a range of services which are designed to make your everyday life easier and more convenient. You decide which services you want to add, and you always have full control over the content. We are continuously adding new services and you are invited to share feedback and submit ideas to e-Boks Plus through the app.
It is easy to get started. You simply log-on as you are used to. If you are new to e-Boks we recommend creating a user with your MitID to get access to all features of the app.

bluejetty:00171503:android.summary: Welcome to Ship Craft: Seaport Tycoon! Dive into the world of boat games and maritime adventure where you can build, manage, and expand your own bustling seaport empire. As a ship builder and seaport master, your journey begins with a singl
bluejetty:00171503:android.description:
Welcome to Ship Craft: Seaport Tycoon! Dive into the world of boat games and maritime adventure where you can build, manage, and expand your own bustling seaport empire. As a ship builder and seaport master, your journey begins with a single dock and a dream to craft the grandest fleet of ships the world has ever seen!
🛠️ Build Your Fleet: Become a renowned ship builder mastering the art of maritime craftsmanship. ⚓
In this captivating boat game, embark on an epic voyage to craft and construct a variety of boats, from a humble raft to a majestic cruise ship and formidable pirate ship. As you progress in Ship Craft: Seaport Tycoon, master the art of ship building and design to create vessels tailored for exploration.
🏗️ Expand Your Seaport: Strategically build and upgrade your port, and watch your empire flourish. 🌐
Explore the vast ocean and navigate through challenging waters in boating games that test your skills as a ship captain. Expand your seaport strategically, building essential facilities such as shipyards, warehouses, and trading posts to support your growing fleet and attract international commerce.
🌍 Explore the Seas: Discover new horizons and embark on exciting expeditions to uncover hidden treasures. 🌊
Challenge yourself in thrilling ship games where you go on quests and uncover blueprints for new ships by catching fish, saving people and finding lost treasures! You must build a boat suitable for different sea quests and awesome cruises in ship building games.
Craft your destiny as the seaport master in Ship Craft: Seaport Tycoon! and embark on a maritime adventure unlike in any other boat games!

Use the app to easily and quickly access your member barcode and check into your Bodifi wellness center. 
Update your Billing information, and make payments from the app
SCHEDULING 
View group fitness schedule inside of the app 
Book your spot so you don’t miss your favorite classes. 
IN-APP WORKOUTS 
View and follow along to fitness on demand workout videos from anywhere!

In app purchases
Purchase products right from the app and pick them up in store.
Bodifi Wellness app uses the Health app that is pre-installed on your iPhone to sync nutrients and workouts data. Because of this, the app will ask you to grant read and write access to your nutrients and workouts data.

bluejetty:00122893:ios.description:
MANAGE YOUR FINANCES ANYTIME, ANYWHERE WITH LIBERTY MOBILE BANKING. 
Become a Liberty customer in minutes, open accounts digitally, get a digital card instantly, add it to Apple Wallet, transfer money, access loans, grow your savings, and send or receive international remittances, all from one secure app. 
BECOME A CUSTOMER IN MINUTES 
Open an account and start banking digitally without visiting a branch. Existing Liberty customers can quickly register and access their banking services through the app. 
SIMPLE AND SECURE ACCESS 
Our username and password, passcode, or biometric authentication for fast and secure access to your finances. 
FINANCIAL OVERVIEW 
View your accounts, cards, deposits, and loans in one place, monitor balances, and stay up to date with your recent transactions. 
CARDS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS 
Create a digital card instantly and start using it right away with Apple Pay. Order and activate cards, block or unblock them, change your PIN, view card details, manage currency priorities, and stay in control of your cards wherever you are. 
MONEY TRANSFERS MADE EASY 
Transfer money between your own accounts, to other people, to credit cards, or to the state treasury. Make instant transfers, send money using an IBAN, phone number, or personal ID number, transfer funds from other banks to Liberty 24/7, save transfer templates, request money, and split expenses with other Liberty users. 
EVERYDAY PAYMENTS 
Top up your mobile balance, pay utility bills, parking fees, fines, and other services directly from your phone. Create payment groups, save templates, and manage recurring everyday payments with ease. 
LOANS AND CREDIT PRODUCTS 
Apply for and activate consumer loans digitally, manage your active loans, make repayments, and access Liberty credit products, including TOP Card, directly from the app. 
SAVE FOR YOUR GOALS 
Open and manage term deposits, savings products, and Money Box to save automatically and achieve your financial goals. 
INTERNATIONAL REMITTANCES 
Receive and send money transfers from abroad quickly and conveniently, without visiting a branch. 
CURRENCY EXCHANGE 
View current and historical exchange rates, exchange currencies using the Mobile Bank rate, request a special exchange rate, and use the built-in currency calculator. 
ACTIVITY AND HISTORY 
Track the status of your operations and easily search or filter your transaction history by account, currency, keyword, or date. 
ATMS AND BRANCHES 
Find nearby ATMs, branches, payment terminals, and other Liberty service locations across Georgia. 
Liberty Mobile Banking helps you manage your everyday finances with confidence, wherever you are.

Become a Liberty customer in minutes, open accounts digitally, get a digital card instantly, add it to Apple Wallet, transfer money, access loans, grow your savings, and send or receive international remittances, all from one secure app. 

BECOME A CUSTOMER IN MINUTES 

Open an account and start banking digitally without visiting a branch. Existing Liberty customers can quickly register and access their banking services through the app. 

SIMPLE AND SECURE ACCESS 

Our username and password, passcode, or biometric authentication for fast and secure access to your finances. 

FINANCIAL OVERVIEW 

View your accounts, cards, deposits, and loans in one place, monitor balances, and stay up to date with your recent transactions. 

CARDS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS 

Create a digital card instantly and start using it right away with Apple Pay. Order and activate cards, block or unblock them, change your PIN, view card details, manage currency priorities, and stay in control of your cards wherever you are. 

MONEY TRANSFERS MADE EASY 

Transfer money between your own accounts, to other people, to credit cards, or to the state treasury. Make instant transfers, send money using an IBAN, phone number, or personal ID number, transfer funds from other banks to Liberty 24/7, save transfer templates, request money, and split expenses with other Liberty users. 

EVERYDAY PAYMENTS 

Top up your mobile balance, pay utility bills, parking fees, fines, and other services directly from your phone. Create payment groups, save templates, and manage recurring everyday payments with ease. 

LOANS AND CREDIT PRODUCTS 

Apply for and activate consumer loans digitally, manage your active loans, make repayments, and access Liberty credit products, including TOP Card, directly from the app. 

SAVE FOR YOUR GOALS 

Open and manage term deposits, savings products, and Money Box to save automatically and achieve your financial goals. 

INTERNATIONAL REMITTANCES 

Receive and send money transfers from abroad quickly and conveniently, without visiting a branch. 

CURRENCY EXCHANGE 

View current and historical exchange rates, exchange currencies using the Mobile Bank rate, request a special exchange rate, and use the built-in currency calculator. 

ACTIVITY AND HISTORY 

Track the status of your operations and easily search or filter your transaction history by account, currency, keyword, or date. 

ATMS AND BRANCHES 

Find nearby ATMs, branches, payment terminals, and other Liberty service locations across Georgia. 

Liberty Mobile Banking helps you manage your everyday finances with confidence, wherever you are.

bluejetty:00179328:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00179328:ios.description:
Repost photos, videos, Reels, and Stories with tools for the words and planning that go with them. Prepare your next share, edit the caption, find relevant hashtags, and schedule posts for later in one app for creators and businesses.
REPOST REELS, STORIES, PHOTOS & VIDEOS
Make reposting part of your routine. Share photos and videos to Stories or Reels, and prepare the accompanying text before you publish. Whether you are sharing your own work again or reposting with a creator's permission, keep the content and its message connected.
MAKE THE CAPTION YOUR OWN
Reposts need context. Copy and edit captions to explain why you are sharing, introduce a topic, or add your perspective. Use the caption editor to adjust your wording before sharing. Keep the original meaning and give credit where it belongs.
HELP WITH AI WRITING
Need a starting point? Use the AI writing tools and text generator to explore ideas for your next caption. Turn a starting thought into a draft, consider another way to phrase your message, and edit the result in your own voice. Review generated text for accuracy and suitability before posting.
FIND RELEVANT HASHTAGS
Use the hashtag tools to find options related to your content. Choose tags that fit the subject and the audience you want to reach. Bring your caption and hashtags together before sharing a post.
PLAN POSTS FOR LATER
Prepare content around your publishing plans with the post scheduler. Schedule posts for later as part of your creator routine, rather than leaving every caption decision until the moment you want to share. Planning ahead gives you time to review the words and the content together.
ADD A WATERMARK
Add a watermark to your media as you prepare it for sharing. Use this alongside thoughtful captions and appropriate creator credit. A watermark does not replace permission to reuse someone else's work or establish ownership of content you did not create.
A WORKFLOW FOR DIFFERENT CREATORS
For personal accounts, bring your perspective to the content you share. For creators and influencers, prepare captions and hashtags alongside your media. For businesses, plan the wording around the message you want a post to communicate. Choose the tools that fit the task, from captions to later posts.
BEFORE YOU SHARE
Check the media, review the caption, and make sure the hashtags are relevant. Confirm that you have the rights or permission needed to repost. Keep attribution accurate, and make your own edits clear. Thoughtful preparation helps your audience understand both the content and why you chose to share it.
REELS REPOST PRO
Reels Repost Pro offers unlimited access to the creator tools through an auto-renewable subscription. Available plans, subscription durations, and prices are displayed in the app before purchase. Features may require a subscription.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, unless an eligible free trial applies. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends, at the price shown for your selected plan.
You can manage or cancel your subscription in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription. If a free trial is offered, eligibility, duration, and the price after the trial are shown before you subscribe. Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends to avoid a charge.
CONTENT RIGHTS & INDEPENDENCE
Only repost content you own or have permission to use. Respect copyright and the terms of the platform you use. Repost is an independent app and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Instagram or Meta.

bluejetty:00127800:ios.description:
Wind Radar Map – Anemometer is a powerful wind radar and wind meter designed for people who need accurate wind speed, gust speed and direction in real time.
This advanced anemometer combines a live wind radar map, interactive forecast layers, marine data, tide and wave information, smart alerts and a dynamic compass in one complete wind tracking solution.
If wind conditions matter to you, this app is built for you.
LIVE WIND RADAR MAP AND FORECAST
The interactive Wind Radar Map lets you visualize live wind speed, gust speed and wind direction directly on detailed weather maps. Switch between current conditions and forecast mode to see how wind, storm systems and marine conditions will evolve over the next 7 days.
With Wind Radar Map – Anemometer you can:
Track live wind speed and gust speed
View wind forecast directly on the map
Monitor storm movement and weather radar data
Check tide and wave conditions
Compare multiple locations instantly
The wind radar map is optimized for sailing, boating, surf sessions, marine navigation, golf planning and drone flights.
ACCURATE ANEMOMETER AND WIND METER
This digital anemometer acts as a professional wind meter in your pocket. Get precise wind speed readings in mph, km/h, m/s or knots. Switch to the Beaufort scale for marine and boating activities.
The wind meter is designed to detect gust speed variations so you can react quickly to changing wind conditions.
Whether you are checking wind speed for sailing, tracking gust speed for surf, measuring wind for golf performance or preparing a drone flight, this anemometer delivers reliable data.
DYNAMIC WIND COMPASS
The built-in compass shows real-time wind direction with a responsive and dynamic interface. The smart wind compass updates instantly as wind shifts, helping you understand crosswind and headwind conditions.
Perfect for marine navigation, boating, sailing, surf orientation, drone pilots and outdoor sports.
SMART ALERTS AND STORM TRACKER
Set custom wind alerts and gust speed alerts to stay ahead of dangerous conditions. Receive notifications when wind speed exceeds your selected threshold or when storms approach your location.
Wind Radar Map – Anemometer allows you to check weather alerts for your favorite locations and verify if any storm, marine or wind warnings are active.
Start your day with daily forecast alerts and never miss important wind updates again.
BUILT FOR MARINE, OUTDOOR AND SPORTS
This Wind Radar and Anemometer app is ideal for:
Sailing and boating
Marine navigation
Surf and kitesurf
Golf wind analysis
Fishing
Storm tracking
Drone flying
Outdoor planning
Unlike generic weather apps, Wind Radar Map – Anemometer focuses on wind intelligence, wind radar precision and gust speed tracking.
WHY CHOOSE WIND RADAR MAP – ANEMOMETER

Professional Anemometer
Accurate Wind Meter
Gust Speed Tracking
Wind Direction Compass
Marine Forecast
Tide and Wave Data
Storm Radar Visualization
Custom Wind Alerts

All features are designed to deliver accurate wind speed, reliable forecast data and powerful wind radar visualization in a clean and intuitive interface.
Download Wind Radar Map – Anemometer today and turn your device into a complete wind radar, marine forecast and digital anemometer solution.
Track wind speed. Monitor gust speed. Follow storm systems. Navigate with your compass. Plan with forecast confidence. Master the wind with Wind Radar Map – Anemometer.

bluejetty:00100637:ios.name: Maze Madness - Brain Puzzle
bluejetty:00100637:ios.summary: Welcome to Maze Madness - the logic puzzle game where every level is a work of art. Solve glowing neon mazes and reveal iconic masterpieces, from the Great Wave to legendary sculptures. This is a puzzle experience you won't find anywhere el
bluejetty:00100637:ios.description:
Welcome to Maze Madness - the logic puzzle game where every level is a work of art. Solve glowing neon mazes and reveal iconic masterpieces, from the Great Wave to legendary sculptures. This is a puzzle experience you won't find anywhere else.
It isn't just a simple tap game - it combines snake-style untangle logic with classic unblock strategy. If you are looking for puzzle games for adults that truly test your spatial thinking, you have found the perfect match. Tap away lines, untangle knots, and watch a masterpiece appear!
HOW TO PLAY: MASTER THE MAZE
- TAP & RELEASE: Tap a piece to send it flying along its path. But be careful - each piece only moves in one direction!
- ZOOM & SCAN: Use the Zoom feature to inspect tight spots and find the pieces buried deep in the tangle.
- USE THE GRID: Toggle the Grid Lines to align your view and plan every move with precision.
- THINK IN LAYERS: Find the right order. Remove the outer layer first to open the way out.
WHY YOU WILL LOVE MAZE MADNESS?
A Gallery of Art Mazes
This is where Maze Madness stands apart: levels inspired by the world's most famous paintings and sculptures. Clear the board line by line and watch the Great Wave, timeless statues, and classic portraits emerge from the neon glow. Solving a puzzle has never felt this cultured.
Stunning Neon Aesthetic
Enjoy a clean, minimalist look with glowing lines on a dark background. It's easy on the eyes and perfect for night play. If you love the visual style of minimalist puzzles, you will feel right at home.
Challenging Puzzle Games for Adults
Prepare for a real mental test. Handcrafted special levels and complex knots demand deep critical thinking and spatial reasoning - a cognitive workout designed to sharpen your IQ.
Relaxing Flow & NO TIMER
Stress-free gaming at its best! Perfect for your daily commute, a coffee break, or winding down before bed. No rush, no pressure - just you and the flow.
Zoom & Grid Assistance
Don't let complex shapes stop you! Use our Grid Assistance and Zoom tools to see every detail and solve even the trickiest brain puzzle.
3000+ Creative Levels
From famous masterpieces to cute animals and abstract shapes, every level is a unique surprise. There is always a new picture to look forward to in your tap away journey.
Perfect for Fans of Logic & Brain Games
If you enjoy untangle puzzles, logic challenges, or classic unblock mechanics, Maze Madness is your next obsession. It blends layered strategy with the pure satisfaction of a tap away puzzle game.
Don't let the tangle fool you - with the right strategy, every piece has a way out. Can you clear the board and reveal every masterpiece?
Tap away the chaos today!

bluejetty:00180477:ios.summary:
SmartGo One is the only Go app you’ll need, whether you’re just getting started or already a seasoned player. Learn, play, study, and improve with SmartGo One.
Experience the ancient game of Go on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac in a whole new w
bluejetty:00180477:ios.description:
SmartGo One is the only Go app you’ll need, whether you’re just getting started or already a seasoned player. Learn, play, study, and improve with SmartGo One.
Experience the ancient game of Go on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac in a whole new way. Also known as igo (囲碁), wéiqí (围棋), or baduk (바둑), Go begins with an empty board that gradually fills as players surround territory and capture stones.
Start with a 9x9 board and move up to 13x13 and 19x19 as your skills grow. SmartGo One adapts to your strength, automatically adjusting handicaps so games remain competitive and enjoyable. And when you’re ready for a serious challenge, the powerful KataGo-based engine delivers strong, rewarding play.
But SmartGo One is far more than a way to play Go. Read interactive Go books while replaying the moves they describe to deepen your understanding. Explore a collection of more than 138,000 professional game records spanning both modern and historical masters. Improve your reading and decision-making skills with a growing library of Go problems and tutorials.
Want to know how a master would handle a position on your board? SmartGo’s pattern matching technology compares your game with historical pro games and shows how strong players approached similar situations. No matter your level, SmartGo One helps you continue improving.
Features include:
• 9x9, 11x11, 13x13, and 19x19 board sizes
• Powerful KataGo-based engine
• Fast and responsive gameplay
• Manual or automatic handicap adjustment
• Record, annotate, and edit your games
• Territory estimator
• Hints and move analysis
• Undo and replay controls
• Tutorial with over 100 problems
• Extensive user manual
We value your privacy and only collect the minimum information necessary to make our apps work well for you. Learn more at https://smartgo.com/privacy.html.
This app is licensed under Apple’s standard Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

• Offline reading — Save your favorite stories and take them anywhere
• Clean, reader-first experience — No clutter, no noise — just great content, beautifully presented
From Rolex to Richard Mille, Seiko to Patek Philippe, the HODINKEE app is your gateway to the stories that make watches matter.

bluejetty:00071411:ios.description:
B612 is the best all-in-one camera & photo/video editing app. We offer various free features and tools to make every moment more special.

*Create your own filters*
- Create a one-of-a-kind filter and share it with friends
- No problem even if it's your first time creating a filter. Filters are easily completed with just a few touches.
