bluejetty:00166430:ios.description:
Ever wondered what you'd look like with a different hair color or style? Or maybe you're curious about how you'd appear in a professional headshot? Beautify has got you covered.
Whether you're looking to switch up your hairstyle, try on a new hair color, or even see yourself in a video, this app is your ultimate playground. It's like having a personal stylist and photographer right in your pocket. Plus, it's perfect for those who love to explore and express their unique style.
Here's what Beautify can do for you:
1. AI Hair Face Analysis: Get insights into your face shape and features to find the hairstyles and colors that suit you.
2. AI Hair Color Changer: See how you'd look with a new hair color. From bold and vibrant to subtle and natural, the choice is yours.
3. AI Hairstyle Try-On: Experiment with different hairstyles without the scissors. Whether it's a chic bob or long waves, find your next look effortlessly.
4. AI Headshot: Need a professional photo for your profile or resume? Create stunning headshots with just a few taps.
5. AI Photo to Video: Bring your photos to life by transforming them into dynamic videos. Perfect for sharing on social media or just for fun.
Beautify is all about making self-expression easy and exciting. It's designed for anyone who loves to play with their look, whether you're a fashion enthusiast, a social media influencer, or just someone who enjoys trying new things. So why wait? Discover a new you today!

- For some features of Beautify, a Premium subscription is needed.
- Payment will be made from your iTunes account after you confirm the purchase.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings in the iTunes store after purchase.
- You can cancel your subscriptions by entering: http://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy: https://idealabs.mobi/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://idealabs.mobi/terms-of-service

~~> Get ready for the biggest dance battle competition of the year and show the world which dancers rule! 
~~> Who will be the winners of the big show - ballerinas or hip hop dancers?!
~~> Dance like you’ve never danced before, and win first place in the spectacular dance off!
Choose whether you want to be team ballet or team hip hop, and get dancing! Ballet and hip hop have both got great things about them - ballerinas are graceful and elegant, and hip hop dancers are super cool. But only one crew can win the show and rule the dance floor - who will it be?!
Features:
> Choreograph your own dance moves and knock the judges’ socks off at the big dance off show!
> Dress up in the fabbest dance costumes ever!
> You even get to choose your own crew members. Choose wisely - you need a good team to win the dance off competition!
> You’ve got to shine like a star on that stage - get a makeover and a killer hairdo to look amazing!
> Climb the ranks and dance your way to the top!
> Keep your eyes on the prize - make that golden trophy yours!
> Decorate the stage for the big dance battle!
> Play a fun dance minigame and vote for the best dance team! Who will be the lucky winner?!
> Dancers have got to stay fit! Get in shape at the gym!
> Sometimes dancing comes with injuries. Go to the doctor to get better before the show!
> You better calm those pre-show jitters. Relax and pamper yourself at the spa!

名师播客、名人演讲、深度采访、TED……从兴趣出发，学地道英语，用英语打开新世界大门

热门英剧、高分美剧、经典电影原声，回味经典必备

音视频课程均配有中英同步课文，还可切换为单语/无课文模式练习听写和翻译
【查询生词】
在课文中长按单词查询释义，一键加入本课收藏＆生词本，还可同步至「不背单词App」学习
【逐句精听】
为精听练习量身定制，支持自定义循环次数和间隔时间，攻破听力难点和句型盲点
【跟读测评】
跟读即时测评口语发音，对比原音纠正发音，练就纯正口语
【变速播放】
九档语速按需调节，不落下任何发音细节
【收藏句子】
一键收藏好句到本课收藏＆句库，集中欣赏或跟读模仿，通过语境学表达
【单词集】
记生词还能用听的，考前刷词更省时间，走在路上也能学

应用内：账号 - 帮助中心

1. 订阅服务：轻听 1 个月 VIP，轻听 1 年 VIP

5. 取消续订：在有效订阅期内不能取消当前订阅。如需取消续订，请在当前订阅周期到期至少 24 小时前，手动在 iTunes/Apple ID 设置管理中关闭自动续订，关闭后将不再扣费。

bluejetty:00175592:ios.description:
Make every day a little more rewarding with Upside, the ultimate cash back rewards app for gas, groceries, and dining.
Your regular grocery run. Your usual fill-up. Your go-to dinner spot. Upside fits right into your life, giving you real cash back on the things you already buy, without changing a thing about how you shop.
How Upside works
- Find offers near you
- Claim an offer before you pay
- Pay as usual with your credit or debit card
- Earn cash back in your account
Cash out whenever you want.
Earn cash back on the things you already buy
Upside works across the everyday purchases you're already making:
Gas: Stop overpaying at the pump, check live gas prices at participating locations, and find the best deals at the gas stations. With offers at 30,000+ station gas locations nationwide, including major brands like Circle K, Caseys, Murphys, Shell, Gulf, Sunoco, Marathon, there's almost always an offer close by. Earn up to 25¢/gal on your first fill-up. We partner with local businesses and big brands so you can earn cash back on top of your existing fuel rewards and loyalty programs.
Groceries: Earn cash back on your weekly grocery run at participating stores. Get an average 13% cash back in select markets, and make the most of what's already on your list.
Dining: Earn cash back when you dine out or grab takeout at local restaurants and national favorites like Taco Bell, Pizza Hut, Jersey Mikes and Dominos. 
Download the app to see offers near you.
Simple, flexible ways to earn
- No coupons to clip, no codes to remember
- Check in or upload a receipt, depending on the offer
- Stack Upside cash back on top of your credit card rewards, fuel rewards, and loyalty programs
- Works across gas, groceries, and dining, all in one app
Upside fits into how you already pay and earn. A fill-up becomes a small win. A grocery run adds up. Dinner out feels a little smarter. That's the idea.
Cash back that's actually yours
- No points, no converting, what you see is what you get
- No redemption minimum, cash out whenever you want
- Cash out to your bank account or gift cards
- Track every dollar right in the app
Why people keep coming back to Upside
Because it works without asking you to do more. You don't need to hunt for deals, clip coupons, or rethink how you spend. Upside quietly turns the purchases you were already going to make into something that earns you back a little more, fill-up after fill-up, grocery run after grocery run, dinner after dinner. Small choices that add up to something that actually feels worth it.
And because there are no points to decode, no minimums to hit, and no hoops to jump through, what you earn is simply yours.
A win for you — and the places you go
We partner with local businesses and big brands to bring you relevant offers nearby. You earn cash back. Businesses grow. And Upside only earns when both sides win.
Trusted by millions
Join 5 million+ people who've already earned over $1 billion in cash back on gas, groceries, and restaurants. With a 4.8-star rating in the App Store, Upside is the kind of app that quietly becomes part of your routine — because it fits around your life, not the other way around. Frequent users earn an average of $255 in their first year, and there's probably an offer near you right now.
Download Upside and start earning cash back today.

bluejetty:00076296:ios.summary:
Locationscout is your bucket list, trip planner, and photo spot finder in one. Plan road trips, track visited places, and discover amazing locations worldwide.
YOUR PERSONAL BUCKET LIST, TRAVEL & ROAD TRIP INSPIRATION
Get inspired for you
bluejetty:00076296:ios.description:
Locationscout is your bucket list, trip planner, and photo spot finder in one. Plan road trips, track visited places, and discover amazing locations worldwide.
YOUR PERSONAL BUCKET LIST, TRAVEL & ROAD TRIP INSPIRATION
Get inspired for your next trip whether it's the stunning fjords of Norway, the rugged coasts of Portugal, the natural wonders of New Zealand and Iceland, or an epic road trip through Italy and Argentina. From the vibrant streets of Berlin to hidden spots, find your next adventure.
Use the "Explore" feature to find places you've never visited and save them in your personal bucket list (bookmarks). Track countries you've been to and plan where to go next.
(Re-) discover nearby places with Around Me. With over 233.000 entries across more than 184 countries available in Locationscout, you'll certainly find a hidden spot. Who said a bucket list is only for places far away?
LOCATION & TRAVEL INFORMATION, PHOTOGRAPHY TIPS, COORDINATES & MORE
Locationscout is built upon millions of amazing photos provided by professional and hobby photographers who love to share their passion and experiences with the community. Similar to geocaching, you can explore and check off amazing photo spots around the world.
But that's just the beginning.
Beyond inspiring photos, find essential information such as local insights, travel tips, photography equipment recommendations, exact spot coordinates, parking details, and much more. Whether you're planning a road trip through multiple countries or searching for the perfect sunset spot, Locationscout has got you covered.
Locationscout is an invaluable trip planner for photographers, road trip enthusiasts, nature lovers, geocaching & astrophotography fans, and anyone looking to turn their travel dreams into reality.
-------------------------------------------
LOCATIONSCOUT - FEATURES
-------------------------------------------
• Search over 233.000 entries across countries like the US, Germany, Iceland, Norway, Italy, Portugal, and New Zealand
• Personal bucket list: Save and track visited places like a travel achievement system
• Plan epic road trips through countries like Iceland and Argentina with our comprehensive location database
• Join a bustling community of over 166.000 photography and travel enthusiasts
• Discover photo spots from Berlin's urban landscapes to New Zealand's natural wonders
• Get essential details for each location including crowd levels, best visiting times, and sunrise/sunset info
• Built-in road trip planner with maps and local tips to ensure smooth adventures
• Track visited countries and locations to build your travel achievements
• Find popular spots or hidden spots off the beaten path - perfect for geocaching enthusiasts
• Customize your experience with light and dark mode
• Share your discoveries with fellow travelers (via www.locationscout.net)
• Earn money by making your photos licensable (via www.locationscout.net)
Whether you're planning a road trip through the fjords of Norway, exploring the coast of Portugal, or seeking hidden spots in Berlin, Locationscout helps you discover and track incredible places. Use it as your bucket list manager and trip planner to scope out destinations before you visit. From the glaciers of Iceland to the valleys of Argentina, find the perfect spots for photography and adventure.
Our passionate community has curated locations across countries worldwide, making it easy to find scenic spots whether you're an experienced photographer or just starting out. Like geocaching, but for amazing photo locations, Locationscout helps you track visited places and discover new ones.
Download Locationscout now for free and start planning your next adventure!
-- Manuel, Founder & Solo Developer of Locationscout
P.S. For questions please visit www.locationscout.net/app/support. You can find our terms at www.locationscout.net/terms and our privacy at www.locationscout.net/privacy.

bluejetty:00133545:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Welcome to Beth Harmon's world. Take chess lessons, play puzzles and matches, or compete against friends online in this stunning love letter to the show.
From beginners to chess masters, this immersive chess experience pays homage to the award-winning drama and has something for everyone.
MAP YOUR CHESS PROGRESSION
• A beautifully rendered map of Beth's local haunts will act as your central hub throughout the game. 
• Play custom games on 3D or 2D chess boards, track weekly game goals to earn rewards, learn your and friends' stats, access a chess lesson library and more through this central map. 
SEE CHESS LIKE BETH
• Take advantage of the game's unique "Beth Vision" feature to visualize your next move or see threats on the board, just like Beth in the show.
LEARN TO PLAY CHESS IN MULTIPLAYER MODE OR SOLO
• Play chess matches with friends or play against sophisticated AI that replicates the playing level and style of your favorite characters. 
• Multiplayer modes include: multiplayer online matchmaking, multiplayer online invite a friend, or in-person pass & play with a friend.
MEET UP WITH OLD FRIENDS AND FAMILIAR FACES
• Learn chess with Mr. Shaibel, engage in chess matches with Borgov or challenge Beth to matches in the park. Checkmate.
LEARN THE LANGUAGE OF CHESS
• Are you a beginner, or just need a lingo refresher? Use the in-game glossary to learn new terms or track ones you've already learned. 
• Track everything from move evaluations (book, blunder, mistake) to general terms (checkmate, ranks, files) and advanced terms (fianchetto, pins, fork) as you play.
FUN WAYS TO PLAY, LEARN CHESS AND LEVEL UP
• Pick a skill level and take chess lessons at a pace that's right for you. Players are able to pick from three different levels of increasing difficulty (novice, intermediate, advanced).
• Make a mistake? Try again by taking advantage of the "undo" feature in the game. You can also analyze your moves by pressing the "review" button to learn from mistakes, improve your movements and take advantage of missed opportunities. 
• Collect custom postcards and earn unique rewards for your profile to show off to your friends.
• Complete a variety of puzzles to gain the skills you need to play like a master of chess.
- Created by Rockwater Games, a Ripstone Studio.

bluejetty:00013872:ios.summary:

Use the app to create a geofence—a virtual boundary—around your workplace. Then, whe
bluejetty:00013872:ios.description:
Blip is a free app for BrightHR customers. It lets you easily track your employees’ work hours and locations on the go. Here’s how it works: 
Geolocation 
Use the app to create a geofence—a virtual boundary—around your workplace. Then, when your employees enter or leave the geofence, Blip picks up their location and asks them to clock in or out, helping you to know exactly where your staff have worked and how long for. 
QR codes 
Alternatively, you can use Blip’s smart scanning system to record your employees’ work hours instead. 
Your staff use Blip to scan a QR code—a type of barcode—when they arrive and leave work. Then, each time they scan the code, Blip will register them as clocked in or out. It’s that simple. 
Breaks
Blip makes it easy to track breaks, too. At the tap of a button, your staff can log the start and end of their breaks, so you can see how long and how often they take downtime. 
How Blip helps you:
 - Check your employees’ work hours and track their location in an instant. 
 - Keep an eye on your employees’ breaks and make sure they’re getting enough downtime. 
 - Change an incorrect shift or break time in a few quick taps.
 - Create multiple locations and easily track where your employees have worked.
 - View a full history of an employee’s work hours and filter the date range easily.
 - Export the work history for an individual or team and save it as a spreadsheet for your records.

bluejetty:00150511:ios.description:
KSMART is an initiative of Information Kerala Mission to provide citizens , a convenient and efficient way to access services from the local self government institutions such as Birth Certificates , Marriage Certificates etc. The app aims to strengthen the relationship between the local governments and citizens by improving transparency, efficiency and accountability in the governance process.
 The app helps to streamline public services. It provides self-service access to local government services, improve responsiveness and efficiency across all services, and reduce the human labour involved in serving many of the citizen needs. 
 We envisage to incorporate different functional modules used in local self government institutions into a single mobile app. Civil registration, file management, building permit, property tax, public grievance redressal, human resource management system, welfare pensions are some of the upcoming modules in this mobile app.

Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!

- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.

bluejetty:00187931:ios.name: Cash Register Express
bluejetty:00187931:ios.summary: This app is designed to calculate a sale fast and determine change quickly without making mistakes. It is very powerful, yet extremely simple to use. Setting up an item list only takes a minute and can be copied to multiple devices if neede
bluejetty:00187931:ios.description:
This app is designed to calculate a sale fast and determine change quickly without making mistakes. It is very powerful, yet extremely simple to use. Setting up an item list only takes a minute and can be copied to multiple devices if needed. Additionally setting up a discount and/or sales tax for the sale is a snap. This app supports many currencies and contains powerful features not found in very expensive POS systems.
The design of the app is what makes the sales transaction fast and accurate. The total sale is automatically calculated each time the quantity is changed. Sales totals by item and receipt details are automatically saved.
To calculate change, touch the currency denomination buttons the customer pays with and the app will calculate what bills and coins to give back as change. This eliminates any math errors that could waste time and money.
The free app creates a list of up to 2 items. An in-app purchase will allow up to 108 items.
Team Selling is now available in the app. An example of this would be a school fundraiser where all the students in the school are selling the same items. A master item list is created by the team leader and is distributed to all the team members automatically when the student logs in to the team.
The full version has these features:
1) Sales Reports
2) Inventory
3) 4 Stores with up to 108 items in your item list for each store.
4) Inventory Tracking
5) Team Selling. For more than 1 employee
6) Email or Message a receipt.
7) Copy item list from one device to another.
8) Lock all settings so employees can't change anything.
9) Order fulfillment. Example, a food truck takes the order and automatically sends the order to the kitchen area.
10) 3 different ways to set the quantity for an item sold.
This app is perfect for vendors at a variety of places such as kiosks, concession stands, trade shows, food carts, hot dog stands, flea markets, bazaars, news stands, school stores, craft & food fairs, boardwalk vendors, street vendors, carnivals, flight attendants on airplanes, and many more!

- Weight concerns
- Diabetes and pre-diabetes
- Sports nutrition
- Gut health
- High blood pressure
- High cholesterol
- PCOS
- Autoimmune
- General health
- Emotional eating

- Effective: 93% of clients improve eating habits and 85% improve lab results
- Affordable: clients pay as little as $0 with insurance
Here are some of the app's many features:
- Schedule and manage appointments with your dietitian
- Chat with your dietitian whenever you like
- Log meals and how you’re feeling in your journal
- And much more to come!

bluejetty:00166333:ios.summary:

With the app you can…
• Shop fram
bluejetty:00166333:ios.description:
Our app is the easiest way to shop for Warby Parker eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contacts. Our eyeglasses start at $95 (prescription included!), and free shipping and returns are included with every order.
With the app you can…
• Shop frames starting at $95, including prescription lenses—plus sunglasses!
• Get personalized frame recommendations from our AI-powered Advisor feature
• Virtually try on frames with lifelike accuracy
• Shop top brands of daily, bi-weekly, and monthly contacts with no hidden fees
• Handle all of your eyewear prescriptions with ease
• Measure your pupillary distance (PD) in no time—no card or ruler necessary
Warby Parker has your eyes covered. Whether you’re looking for designer eyewear at a revolutionary price or your next supply of contacts, you can handle it all in one place. With free shipping and returns, it’s easy to shop with no risk (None! Zero! Zilch!). Plus: Apps are fun. As always, for every pair purchased, a pair of glasses is distributed to someone in need.
Let’s find you an amazing pair.
Some features in this app incorporate Apple's TrueDepth API. In order to use these features, users must agree to Warby Parker’s terms and conditions of use. Warby Parker's TrueDepth features look at multiple data points on the user’s face only while they are interacting with the tool. We do not save or store any face scan data for any user or share with any third-parties.
• For Virtual Try-On and Find your width, the terms are: “By tapping ‘Okay,’ you agree to give us access to your camera and to measure your facial features. (FYI: We won’t store or share these measurements – and will only collect and use them while you are using the [tool].)”
* For our Digital PD tool, we ask the user to opt-in for a second time: “By tapping ‘Okay,’ you agree to give us access to your camera and to measure your facial features. (FYI: We won’t store your pupillary distance (PD) measurement without your permission–and will only collect it while you are using the PD tool.).” Once a user agrees, we measure their “Pupillary Distance." Once we have a measurement, users can choose if they’d like to update and store this measurement with their Warby Parker glasses prescription details. If they choose to add this data to their prescription, the pupillary distance measurement is added to their Warby Parker glasses prescription details and not shared with any third-party. If they choose not to add these data to their existing Warby Parker prescription, we do not store these data or share with any third-parties.
Privacy policy: https://www.warbyparker.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.warbyparker.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00083471:ios.summary:

Whether you are looking for your first internship, a high-paying executive ro
bluejetty:00083471:ios.description:
Find your next career move with Jooble, a global job search engine that aggregates thousands of vacancies from 140,000+ online resources into one easy-to-use app.
Whether you are looking for your first internship, a high-paying executive role, or a flexible remote side hustle, Jooble connects you with the best opportunities across 69 countries. Stop surfing dozens of job boards — get full access to company sites, social networks, and forums in one place.
How Jooble Solves Your Job Hunt 
- Searching for your first job? Use our filters to discover entry-level positions and internships tailored to your education.
- Need a specific work setup? Quickly find remote, part-time, freelance, or full-time jobs that fit your lifestyle.
- Want to work for a specific brand? Use Jooble Research to explore company profiles, reviews, and their latest openings.
- Aiming to stand out? Visit our Advice Center for professional tips on how to update your resume and highlight your hard and soft skills.
Key Features for Efficient Search
- Smart Job Filters: Narrow down results by job title, salary, geographic location (country/state/city), or employment type.
- Instant Apply: Attach your CV once and apply directly to vacancies from your smartphone without any hassle.
- Smart Notifications: Subscribe to specific queries or companies and get instant alerts as soon as a new matching job appears.
- Career Blog: Gain expert insights on career strategies, interview preparation, and resume optimization to get hired faster.
FAQ 
How can I find a job near me using Jooble? 
- Simply set your preferred geographical location in the search bar. You can filter vacancies by city, state, or even specific regions to find the most convenient commute.
Can I apply for jobs without a Jooble resume? 
- Yes. You can create an account and attach your existing CV or resume file directly from your smartphone to apply for any posting instantly.
How do I get notified about new job openings? 
- You can set custom alerts for specific professions or companies. Jooble will send you instant email and phone notifications the moment a new vacancy is posted.
Is Jooble free for job seekers? 
- Yes, Jooble provides free access to all job seekers worldwide. You can search, filter, and apply for thousands of jobs from multiple sources at no cost.
Which countries does Jooble cover? 
- Jooble aggregates job listings in 69 countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, and most of Europe.
Global Reach & Authority 
4.7* rated on the App Store · 140,000+ sources aggregated · 20+ years in the job search market · trusted by millions of job seekers across 69 countries.
Jooble scans classifieds, company career pages, and social networks globally — so every relevant vacancy reaches you, no matter where it's posted.
jooble.org ·
help.jooble.org Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: jooble.org/info/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00091228:ios.description:
Qissah is an Islamic stories app for families: 48 narrated stories of the Prophets, from the Qur'an and from the life of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), in up to 10 languages (English, Arabic, German, Dutch, French, Turkish, Swedish, Spanish, Indonesian and Malay). It also has a full Qur'an reader with recitations, an AI chat for questions about Islam, prayer times, adhkar and a dhikr counter.
Qissah is free to download on iPhone and iPad. Qissah Premium, a subscription, unlocks every story and the features above.
Quran Stories in 10 Languages
Discover timeless stories from the Qur'an narrated in English, Arabic, French, German, Dutch, Turkish, Spanish, Swedish, Indonesian, and Malay. Each story comes with beautiful artwork, subtitles, and soothing background sounds for a captivating listening experience.
AI Quran Companion
Chat with your AI buddy about any topic — wisdom, daily life challenges, spirituality, Qur'an verses, and more. Get personalized guidance and thoughtful conversations tailored to your spiritual journey.
Prayer Times & Dhikr
Never miss a prayer — view accurate local prayer times and set gentle notifications. Practice your daily Dhikr with guided counters, track your streak, and build a meaningful daily routine.
Full Qur'an Access
Dive into the Holy Qur'an: browse the complete text of 114 surahs, listen to high-quality recitations, and explore both reading and listening modes for spiritual enrichment.
Save & Share
Bookmark your favorite stories or verses and share meaningful passages with friends and family to spread inspiration.
Who it's for
Qissah is ideal for anyone looking to deepen their spiritual journey, whether you're familiar with the Qur'an or exploring it for the first time. The app supports self-paced discovery, daily practice, and meaningful reflection in a calm, engaging environment.
Start your journey now
Download Qissah and begin exploring stories of faith and perseverance, practicing remembrance, staying connected to your prayers, and engaging with the Divine message through intuitive, thoughtful tools.
Privacy Policy: https://qissahapp.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://qissahapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00131914:ios.summary: Last Island of Survival is your last fortress of surviving this wasted open world. Make your own rules of survival in this multiplayer zombie survival game full of action and adventures! Start an exciting journey and lifeafter on this post-
bluejetty:00131914:ios.description:
Last Island of Survival is your last fortress of surviving this wasted open world. Make your own rules of survival in this multiplayer zombie survival game full of action and adventures! Start an exciting journey and lifeafter on this post-apocalyptic island and survive hunger, dehydration, dangerous wildlife and other malicious survivors. Scavenge resources, craft weapons, and build shelter to survive. Will you be the last of us standing? 
Explore the unpredictable zombie island
Ruins are everywhere, evil walking dead are covered in blood, rusted military choppers are snooping left and right. Find out what happened here and how long can you last! Uncover the secrets of the island in its last days of civilization, check out the huge open world map and source for valuable items and blueprints to gear up and to protect yourself!
Experience the total freedom to play
Set up your own rules of playing! Being a team player or loner, make new friends or enemies, it’s all up to you! Find trustworthy teammates, grow a clan and dominate the island, or make a terrifying name all by yourself. Build giant fortresses and base or show your power by blowing up enemies and raid their homes. You are the one to decide what to do in this online survival mobile game.
Unfold your creativity of building
Explore this huge island for gathering resources and claiming places, that you can call home. It can be a cozy hut in the snowy ice field, an impressive fortress guarding the outskirts of the desert, or a conveniently placed outpost for expeditions. Just build whatever your heart desires. But beware of the worst enemies – rust and decay. In this last days on earth, you will need to maintain your structures to protect them from rust and defend them against your enemies. 
Last man standing 
Last Island of Survival is a PVP focused online mobile game. From the unification of the island to a brutal bloodbath battle is only one step away. All these survival actions are on your mobile device! Be ready to fight! Craft various powerful weapons or find ones that covered in rust, join a team or be a lone wolf, fight for your life, or perish. Raid enemy forts and steal valuable loot from them. Build invincible fortress and defend it with your clan. The opportunities are vast, you only need to take and survive!
PLEASE NOTE
Network connection is required.
Last Island of Survival is free to download and play. Some in-app items can also be purchased for real money. In-app purchases can be disabled through your device’s settings.
By downloading this app, you agree to our privacy policy and terms of use.

Follow us on Facebook for updates, reward events and more!
https://www.facebook.com/LastDayRules/

bluejetty:00062899:ios.description:
mi Flight Tracker is a simple yet powerful tool that allows you to track planes all over the world and get live status information. Whether you are a professional pilot or crew member, planning your own trip or just want to an app to track the flights of your family and friends you'll find the information that you need.
mi Flight Tracker provides live status updates of your flight 24/7, the #1 travel app in over 65 countries.
FEATURES
• Track flights across the world 
• Easy to search for individual flights using flight number or route
• Be the first to be updated of delays
• Detailed Departure and Arrival information 
• Flight radar mode enabling you to see the flight position on zoomable maps
• Plots the actual flight track and updates with latest arrival time
• Terminal and Gate information updated in real-time
• Layover information is automatically displayed 
• mi Flight Tracker enables you to track your flights progress whilst on board the aircraft using the the inbuilt physics based flight model. The model works in flight safe mode.
• Save and share your flight information via e-mail, Facebook, and Twitter
We are passionate about providing innovative flight status and tracking apps giving you the information you need to make your travel smoother. We are continuing to develop the app to add in new functionality and improve the user experience.
Upgrade to mi Flights Premium service to unlock flight notifications pushed directly to your phone. We do the flight tracking for you behind the scenes and notify you of changes when they occur.
There is one subscription and three ways of paying, monthly (bronze), 6 monthly (silver), or yearly (gold). This is an auto-renewing subscription to flight updates via push notifications. Get updates on departure & arrival times, latest delays, gate & baggage reclaim changes. No commitment, you can cancel any time. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
See our other flight tracker apps.
• mi Flight Radar
• mi Flight Board
www.miflightsapp.com
Questions, feedback or comments? Email us: info@miflightsapp.com. We answer all emails quickly!
Terms and conditions: http://www.miflightsapp.com/terms_and_conditions.html
Privacy policy: http://www.miflightsapp.com/privacy_policy.html
Note that this app does not require GPS updates and operates in flight safe mode except for real-time flight status and tracking where the device needs an internet connection.

bluejetty:00070411:ios.description:
HiCoffee is a powerful caffeine tracker that makes it easy to record your daily caffeine intake. It includes data for more than 2,500 branded coffee products, and its Caffeine Calculator can estimate the caffeine in homemade drinks such as espresso and pour-over coffee.
HiCoffee can set a caffeine limit based on your sensitivity and give you personalized suggestions. It helps you enjoy coffee when you need focus, while reducing the chance that too much caffeine gets in the way of your sleep at night. HiCoffee can also look at your long-term resting heart rate and sleep duration, helping you understand how caffeine may be affecting your health.
HiCoffee works beautifully across the Apple ecosystem, with rich widgets, excellent Apple Watch support, Shortcuts, Health data sync, and more. Reliable iCloud sync lets you use HiCoffee with confidence on multiple devices. HiCoffee also supports Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and other accessibility features for a comfortable, smooth experience.
---
** Recognition **
- Featured by the App Store multiple times, including App of the Day, Fresh Apps, Interactive Widgets, and accessibility-focused collections.
- Mentioned during Tim Cook's 2023 visit to China and covered by several media outlets.
- Appeared in the WWDC 2023 and WWDC 2024 keynotes.
- Featured by well-known coffee creator James Hoffmann on his channel.
- Recommended multiple times by creator Nikias Molina.
- Reviewed by German tech publication t3n.
- Recommended by SSPAI as a dynamic caffeine monitoring tool worth watching.
---
** Premium Membership and Subscription **
HiCoffee's premium features can be unlocked in the app through a one-time purchase or a subscription. You can find the purchase options in the app's Settings page. If you choose to unlock premium features with a subscription, payment will be charged automatically to your App Store account within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. After subscribing, you can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in HiCoffee's Settings page or in your App Store account settings. To cancel, please do so at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period, otherwise the App Store will renew the subscription automatically.
** A Note from the Developer **
I'm Gong Zhang, the developer of HiCoffee. If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact me from Settings > Contact and Support > Email in the app, or email me directly at hicoffee@gongzhang.zendesk.com. If you enjoy using HiCoffee, a rating or review on the App Store would help me improve it faster.
Privacy Policy: https://gongzhang.io/app/hicoffee/en/privacy
Terms of Use: https://gongzhang.io/app/hicoffee/en/terms

bluejetty:00175217:ios.description:
Savvy Navvy: Your All-in-One Marine Navigation App
Savvy Navvy is the ultimate marine navigation tool that simplifies charts, weather forecasts, tides, GPS tracking, and route planning—right in the palm of your hand. Whether you're out sailing, fishing, or cruising, we take the stress out of navigation, so you can enjoy your time on the water.
From smart routing to real-time GPS positioning and marine weather forecasts, savvy navvy helps you make safer, smarter decisions on the go. Navigate confidently, with up-to-date weather, tide information, and AIS data that keeps you clear of other vessels.
Why Choose Savvy Navvy?
Clutter-Free Charts: No more messy, hard-to-read charts. Our clean, intuitive design helps you map your route with ease, making every journey more enjoyable.
Smart Route Planning: Plot your course effortlessly. Savvy Navvy calculates the best route, factoring in weather, tides, and depth. Plus, you get accurate ETAs so you can plan every detail of your trip.
Real-Time GPS Tracking: Keep track of your location on the water with built-in GPS, so you always know where you are—and where you're heading.
Departure Scheduler: Pick the perfect departure time by considering weather, tides, and daylight. Avoid rough seas and ensure a smoother ride.
AIS Data for Safety: Stay safe with real-time AIS (Automatic Identification System) data that shows nearby vessels, helping you avoid collisions.
Marine Weather Forecasts: Get ahead of the weather with detailed forecasts, including wind speed, swell, and visibility. Navigate safely, no matter the conditions.
Tides and Currents: Access real-time tide and current data for safer passage, integrated directly into your charts.
Marina and Anchorage Info: Find marinas and anchorages with ease. Whether you need fuel, supplies, or a safe place to dock, we’ve got you covered.
Who’s Savvy Navvy For?
Sailors: Plan routes with tools that account for wind, tides, and depth.
Powerboaters: Navigate confidently with GPS and AIS tracking, plus estimate fuel needs for any trip.
Fishermen: Get precise marine weather forecasts, schedule your trips, and mark your favorite fishing spots.
Jetskiers, Kayakers, and Paddleboarders: Enjoy your adventures with reliable charts and GPS tracking.
Why Trust Savvy Navvy?
With over 2 million downloads and multiple marine innovation awards, Savvy Navvy is trusted by boaters around the world. We use official, regularly updated hydrographic data and live weather from top sources, ensuring you’re always equipped with the most accurate information.
We listen to our users, constantly improving the app based on their feedback. Each update reflects real boater needs, making sure your experience on the water gets better with every trip.
Why We're Different
Unlike other navigation apps, savvy navvy lets you sync routes across up to five devices, making it easy to stay connected. Try our free version and explore all features before upgrading.
Download Savvy Navvy today and explore the waters with confidence!
Read our terms of service here: https://www.savvy-navvy.com/terms-of-service

From smart routing to real-time GPS positioning and marine weather forecasts, savvy navvy helps you make safer, smarter decisions on the go. Navigate confidently, with up-to-date weather, tide information, and AIS data that keeps you clear of other vessels.

Why Choose Savvy Navvy?

Clutter-Free Charts: No more messy, hard-to-read charts. Our clean, intuitive design helps you map your route with ease, making every journey more enjoyable.

Smart Route Planning: Plot your course effortlessly. Savvy Navvy calculates the best route, factoring in weather, tides, and depth. Plus, you get accurate ETAs so you can plan every detail of your trip.

Departure Scheduler: Pick the perfect departure time by considering weather, tides, and daylight. Avoid rough seas and ensure a smoother ride.

AIS Data for Safety: Stay safe with real-time AIS (Automatic Identification System) data that shows nearby vessels, helping you avoid collisions.

Marine Weather Forecasts: Get ahead of the weather with detailed forecasts, including wind speed, swell, and visibility. Navigate safely, no matter the conditions.

Tides and Currents: Access real-time tide and current data for safer passage, integrated directly into your charts.

Marina and Anchorage Info: Find marinas and anchorages with ease. Whether you need fuel, supplies, or a safe place to dock, we’ve got you covered.

Who’s Savvy Navvy For?

Sailors: Plan routes with tools that account for wind, tides, and depth.

Powerboaters: Navigate confidently with GPS and AIS tracking, plus estimate fuel needs for any trip.

Fishermen: Get precise marine weather forecasts, schedule your trips, and mark your favorite fishing spots.

Jetskiers, Kayakers, and Paddleboarders: Enjoy your adventures with reliable charts and GPS tracking.

Why Trust Savvy Navvy?

With over 2 million downloads and multiple marine innovation awards, Savvy Navvy is trusted by boaters around the world. We use official, regularly updated hydrographic data and live weather from top sources, ensuring you’re always equipped with the most accurate information.

We listen to our users, constantly improving the app based on their feedback. Each update reflects real boater needs, making sure your experience on the water gets better with every trip.

Why We're Different

Unlike other navigation apps, savvy navvy lets you sync routes across up to five devices, making it easy to stay connected. Try our free version and explore all features before upgrading.

bluejetty:00014463:ios.description:
Learn your music and run rehearsals right from your mobile device using the new RehearScore App!
Sometimes, finding a rehearsal pianist that meets your budgeting and scheduling needs can be challenging. The new RehearScore® is a complete digital rendition of the Piano-Conductor Score, sequenced by a top Broadway accompanist, precisely the way the composer intended. Every musical number (including scene changes, dance music, and underscoring) is recorded in its entirety so you can rehearse even if you don’t have a pianist. 
● Every cast member can have access to RehearScore®
 ○ Simply download the App right from the App Store to access your show! 
● Conduct dance or choral rehearsals.
 ○ With the ability to change the tempo and loop a dance break, you can run multiple rehearsals at once without the need of a separate pianist or recording. 
● Find the right key – transpositions are easy.
 ○ Adjust your songs into the key that best suits your performer.
● Isolate, increase, or remove any particular vocal line.
 ○ Because each singer’s part has been recorded on a separate track, it can be played back with or without accompaniment (or louder or softer, relative to the accompaniment). 
● Click and jump to any measure.
 ○ Measure numbers match each individual score.
● Add cuts and vamps.
 ○ Edit the songs down to the specific cutting you need and find the perfect number of vamps you’ll need in each song. 
● Save your changes.
 ○ After adjusting the songs, save your changes to distribute to your cast and crew.
For more information on Music Theatre International and RehearScore, please visit https://www.mtishows.com/marketplace/resource/pre-performance/rehearscore.

bluejetty:00099638:ios.description:
Ronomics puts the power of humanoid robotics within reach—whether you’re a growing enterprise or an individual. Avoid hefty upfront investments by renting robots for short- or long-term projects, allowing you to test emerging technologies without committing capital. If you find a model you love, connect directly with sellers to negotiate purchases or extended rental.
By listing on our exchange, sellers gain instant visibility to a global audience of businesses and individuals actively seeking robotic solutions—maximizing the return on their development efforts. Buyers benefit from flexible access: rent a prototype for evaluation, lease fleets for seasonal spikes, or secure trial periods before scaling up. This "try-before-you-buy" approach reduces risk and accelerates innovation cycles by validating concepts in real-world environments before major investments.
With a built-in community, discovering the right fit is effortless. Browse peer ratings, user reviews, and expert recommendations to compare performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Participate in open forums, ask technical questions, and see how others have customized robots for similar use cases—so you never have to guess which model is right for your needs.
Integrated messaging and shared workspaces make it easy for buyers and sellers to collaborate on customizations, run diagnostics, update firmware, or co-develop new features—no endless email chains or hidden costs.
Join Ronomics to unlock affordable access to cutting-edge humanoid robotics, accelerate your projects, and tap into a global community pushing the future of intelligent machines forward. It’s free to join and easy to navigate.

bluejetty:00133524:ios.name: MathHero: Math Games for Kids
bluejetty:00133524:ios.summary:
Help kids ages 5–10 master math facts from first addition to multiplication in a story-driven adventure. Trusted by 5M+ families. No ads.
Can math practice be both fun and effective? 
Welcome to MathHero, the story-driven math game designe
bluejetty:00133524:ios.description:
Help kids ages 5–10 master math facts from first addition to multiplication in a story-driven adventure. Trusted by 5M+ families. No ads.
Can math practice be both fun and effective? 
Welcome to MathHero, the story-driven math game designed to help kids ages 5–10 master mental arithmetic while going on an epic adventure! Whether your child is in Kindergarten or 4th grade, MathHero turns practicing addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division into a game they will actually beg to play.
Mental math (the ability to do math calculations in one's head) is a crucial skill for primary students—essential for both academic success and daily life. But mastering it takes time, repetition, and practice. MathHero replaces boring worksheets with an engaging, stress-free world, making learning enjoyable and independent for children.
**Perfect for Every Grade Level**
The game lets you select the exact math facts and operations you would like to master, making it highly customizable for every elementary school grade (K-5):
• Kindergarten: Addition and subtraction within 10
• 1st Grade: Addition and subtraction within 20 (Common Core: CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.1.OA.C.5)
• 2nd Grade: Two-digit addition and subtraction, multiplication tables (CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.2.OA.B.2)
• 3rd Grade: Multiplication and division, addition and subtraction within 100, times tables (CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.3.OA.C.7, CCSS.MATH.CONTENT.3.NBT.A.2)
• 4th Grade: Three-digit addition and subtraction
**Self-Paced & Parent-Controlled**
You can configure the math topics, the type of tasks, and even the speed of the monsters to perfectly match your child's current skill level.
**Story-Driven Gameplay**
Unlocking different levels, battling monsters, upgrading weapons, and collecting outfits for their character guarantees your child won't become bored. Instead, these rewards constantly motivate them to move forward in their learning journey!
Fighting slime monsters is a vastly more entertaining and effective way to achieve daily arithmetic practice than flashcards or traditional quiz apps. Kids from kindergarten all the way up to 4th grade will absolutely love practicing mental math with MathHero!
—
We would love to hear your feedback. In case you have any questions or comments about the game, please write to us at support@mathhero.net.
Terms of Use: https://mathhero.net/terms

Puzzle for kids series (8) are one of the best fun and educational games for young kids, toddlers and preschool children. This top free game will help your child develop matching, tactile and fine motor skills while playing and exploring 100 different food wooden textured puzzle shapes.
Watch them learn all the names of numerous fruits, vegetables and other food items through fun and play - apple, grapes, orange, pineapple, watermelon, banana, kiwi, cherry, strawberry, lemon, corn, peas, carrot, tomato, pepper, mushroom, potato, onion, cucumber, cabbage, milk, egg, bread, water, juice, butter, cheese, yogurt, jam & cereals. bluejetty:00119536:ios.name: Salesforce Authenticator
bluejetty:00119536:ios.summary: Salesforce Authenticator adds an extra layer of security for your online accounts with multi-factor authentication (also known as two-factor authentication). With Salesforce Authenticator, you use your mobile device to verify your identity
bluejetty:00119536:ios.description:
Salesforce Authenticator adds an extra layer of security for your online accounts with multi-factor authentication (also known as two-factor authentication). With Salesforce Authenticator, you use your mobile device to verify your identity when logging in to your account or performing critical actions. The app sends you a push notification, and you approve or deny the activity with just a tap. For even more convenience, Salesforce Authenticator can use your mobile device’s location services to automatically approve account activity that you trust. The app also provides one-time verification codes for use while you’re offline or have low connectivity. 
Use Salesforce Authenticator to secure all your online accounts that support time-based one-time passwords (TOTP). Any service that allows multi-factor authentication using an “Authenticator app” is compatible with Salesforce Authenticator.
Location Data & Privacy
If you enable location-based automation in Salesforce Authenticator, rest assured that Salesforce never tracks your location or shares it with anyone. Location data is stored securely on your mobile device, never in the cloud. You can delete all location data from your device or turn off location services at any time. Learn more about how the app uses location data in Salesforce Help.
Battery Usage
Rather than getting precise location updates, Salesforce Authenticator only receives updates when you enter or leave the approximate area, or “geofence,” of a location that you trust. By minimizing the frequency of location updates, Salesforce Authenticator conserves your mobile device’s battery life. To reduce battery usage even more, you can turn off location services and stop automating your activity.

Army Knots is the ultimate knot tying app designed for the modern soldier! Master the essential knots required for Army Ranger and Army Sapper training. Whether you're a military professional, an outdoor enthusiast, or just someone looking to enhance their survival skills, this app has you covered. With Army Knots, you can avoid the dreaded "no-go" due to not knowing the required knots during your evaluations or training exercises.

- NO PERMISSIONS REQUIRED!

bluejetty:00023685:ios.description:
► SOLVE DRAWING PUZZLE AND BECOME AN ARTIST!
Have you ever wanted a game to challenge your brain and your talent for drawing?
Solve puzzles by using your powers of logic and lateral thinking as you work your way through a huge series of cute drawings that all have something a little bit wrong with them — and it’s up to you to work it out!
Use your finger to draw and outline the shapes of the parts that the drawings need, and then watch the game color and fill in the rest to complete the picture and take you on to the next challenge. 
Once you work out the puzzles you will see that even the funniest drawings are entirely based on logic and lateral thinking, and you will be kicking yourself for even looking at the hints!
Some of the results might surprise you and make you really want to play more!
► INNOVATIVE FEATURES THAT MAKE THIS GAME ONE OF A KIND
• Use your own finger to complete drawings on your screen and let the game fill in the rest of the picture
• A game that is an engaging and fun for your skill at solving puzzles and lateral thinking
• Dozens of beautiful drawings to complete and figure out and keep your brain engaged for hours
• Uniquely refreshing and engaging gameplay which you will be thinking about all day and coming back for more
• A helpful hint system that won’t leave you in a lurch and let you get on with the game whenever you get stuck
• Lovely music written especially for the game, which is relaxing and catchy at the same time and takes you away from the worries of everyday life
• Your progress is saved after every drawing, play the game for as little or as long as you like
• A difficulty which is just right, as it grows and draws you in until you’re solving puzzles and using your powers of logic like a pro
• You don’t have to be a great artist, but it helps!
► A FUN AND RELAXING CHALLENGE
If there is a puzzle that you need a little help with figuring out, there is a helpful hint system that will point your artistic talents in the right direction!
When you play this game, there is a relaxing balance of difficulty and enjoyment where you will feel that you have faced a challenge for your brain but never got annoyed or frustrated.
The gaming sessions can be as long or as short as you want, from solving a single drawing to several hours, as they keep on coming and your progress is always saved!
You can also always play the game together with your friends and family, as your screen doesn’t mind whose finger it is! 
Download this colorful and fun game of artistic riddles today and bring out your inner artist!

bluejetty:00121655:ios.description:
Minesweeper is a classic, throwback PC game that provides hours of fun - plus this version is great for iPad!
The game is simple, try to avoid the bombs to clear the minefield to win the game! Strategy and logic are needed to navigate the multiple levels of difficulty. Monitor your progress with the brand new stats tracker to keep tabs on your progress and try to beat your best times! This retro minesweeper game is just like the original and provides great fun. 
If you like old classic games such as Chess, Checkers, Backgammon, Solitaire, Free Cell as well as classic puzzle games like Sudoku, Tetris, and Crossword Puzzles then this game is for you! 
How to play:
Start with a covered mine field of square tiles and clear the field by tapping one square at a time. But be careful, as underneath some tiles are bombs waiting to be detonated! Beneath each tile is a number (indicates how many mines are touching the tile), a blank space, or a mine waiting to be exploded! Use strategy and logic to navigate the mine map and win the game!
Features:
- Pinch to zoom
- High scores leaderboard for each difficulty setting
- Stats tracking to keep track of your games for each difficulty
- Adjustable difficulty: Beginner, Medium, Difficult, and Custom options to ensure you are always challenged
- Best, smoothest, fastest interface of any iPhone Mine Sweeper game
- Flag Mode: Turn on flag mode to mark tiles you think are bombs quickly
- Portrait and Landscape mode for iPhone and iPad
Be sure to check back again for updates on new features and more!
View our Terms of Service at: https://maplemedia.io/terms-of-service/
View our Privacy Policy at: https://maplemedia.io/privacy/
Thanks for playing Minesweeper Classic! 
Have questions or feedback? Email us at contact@maplemedia.io for fast & friendly support.

Find, organize, and annotate sheet music from the world’s leading publishers with nkoda’s new app. It's simple to study, teach, and perform with unlimited access to scores and performance materials - all easily accessible in one app.
nkoda
bluejetty:00119827:ios.description:
Find, organize, and annotate sheet music from the world’s leading publishers with nkoda’s new app. It's simple to study, teach, and perform with unlimited access to scores and performance materials - all easily accessible in one app.
nkoda features over 110,000 high-quality, fully licensed editions from publishers such as Bärenreiter, Boosey & Hawkes, Breitkopf & Härtel, Casa Ricordi, Chester Music, Faber Music and many more. Our editions span across solo, chamber, orchestral and vocal music, ranging from Classical to Jazz, Contemporary and Pop.
Whether you need to find your next recital programme, study and analyze your favorite works, or access parts in advance of rehearsals, nkoda has you covered. In addition to scores and parts, you can also find educational materials, including beginner to advanced theory and method books.
With nkoda, all materials are available online or offline, at your fingertips, anytime, anywhere.
Our customizable and powerful toolboxes let you work as you choose, and intuitive sharing and organization features make collaborating easy. You can even upload and manage your own scores and enjoy unlimited storage for your collection.
nkoda empowers musicians and simplifies music-making. Discover why musicians worldwide are using nkoda today with a free trial.
**nkoda subscription information:**
Your subscription will be charged to your credit or debit card through your Apple account once the free trial ends.
This will be monthly or annually dependent on your subscription choice. Both subscription options provide access to the unlimited use of our entire library, features, and benefits. These options provide the same service and the only difference is a 20% saving on price when subscribing annually.
If you cancel your subscription before your trial ends, and re-subscribe after your trial has ended, we won’t be able to offer another full free trial. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal or cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user’s Apple account settings after purchase.
For more information, please see:
EULA - https://www.nkoda.com/legal/end-user-agreement 
Privacy policy - https://www.nkoda.com/legal/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00129521:ios.description:
The Keoride NSW app enables you to book a bus to and from anywhere within the “on demand” area. Keoride NSW guarantees you a convenient and more personalised travel experience in and around your local community. With the app you will be able to select your pick up location, tell us where you want to go, and track your bus so you know when to head to the pick up location. Keoride NSW is proudly operated by Keolis Downer and powered by Via. Is Keoride NSW available in your area? Check the app to find out, or go to https://www.keoride.com.au/.
A new way to travel
Keoride NSW matches customers with others going in the same direction via a customised and flexible route. Sophisticated technology coordinates your trip, picking you up from near your home, or a convenient location nearby, and taking you to where you want to go within the “on demand” area.
Ride now or later
You can book rides on-demand or pre-schedule them up to three months in advance.
Minimal wait-times
On average, a vehicle will come in minutes, and you'll always get an estimate of your pickup ETA before booking. You can also track your bus in real-time in the app.
Try Keoride NSW, a new way to travel.
Love our app? Please rate us! 
Questions? Email us at
Sydney - northernbeaches@keolisdowner.com.au

Dwell is the audio Bible app for your whole life with Scripture — whether you're commuting, cooking, falling asleep, or sitting in quiet with the Lord. With over 20 distinct voice recordings and 14 Bible translations, Dwell makes it easy and beautiful to hear the Word of God every single day.
AUDIO BIBLE
Experience the entire Bible narrated by world-class voices, with optional background music to help you focus and go deeper. Choose your translation, pick your narrator, and let Scripture come alive.
- 20+ voice recordings, 14 translations (ESV, NIV, NLT, KJV, CSB, NKJV, NASB, The Message, and more)
- Read Along — follow the text as it scrolls in sync with the narrator
- 75+ listening plans to guide you through Scripture day by day
- Download for offline listening anytime, anywhere
DEVOTIONALS & PRAYERS
Start your morning or end your evening with daily devotional content and guided prayers designed to root you deeper in your faith. Whether you have five minutes or fifty, Dwell meets you where you are.
AUDIOBOOKS
Go deeper with audio content from trusted Christian authors and teachers — a curated library to complement your Scripture listening.
KIDS
Help your children fall in love with God's Word from an early age. Dwell's kids content brings Scripture to life in a way that's engaging and age-appropriate for the whole family.
BUILD A LASTING HABIT
Growth in Christ doesn't happen by accident. Dwell's listening plans, daily reminders, and sleep mode make it easy to return to Scripture morning, night, and every moment in between.
- Sleep mode — fall asleep to the Word being read over you
- Scripture memorization with Repeat & Reflect
- Create and share personalized Scripture playlists
- 300+ curated Passages and 100+ themed Playlists to explore

– Matt Chandler

listings.description:
Hear God's Word. Grow in faith daily.

Dwell is the audio Bible app for your whole life with Scripture — whether you're commuting, cooking, falling asleep, or sitting in quiet with the Lord. With over 20 distinct voice recordings and 14 Bible translations, Dwell makes it easy and beautiful to hear the Word of God every single day.

AUDIO BIBLE
Experience the entire Bible narrated by world-class voices, with optional background music to help you focus and go deeper. Choose your translation, pick your narrator, and let Scripture come alive.

- 20+ voice recordings, 14 translations (ESV, NIV, NLT, KJV, CSB, NKJV, NASB, The Message, and more)
- Read Along — follow the text as it scrolls in sync with the narrator
- 75+ listening plans to guide you through Scripture day by day
- Download for offline listening anytime, anywhere

DEVOTIONALS & PRAYERS
Start your morning or end your evening with daily devotional content and guided prayers designed to root you deeper in your faith. Whether you have five minutes or fifty, Dwell meets you where you are.

AUDIOBOOKS
Go deeper with audio content from trusted Christian authors and teachers — a curated library to complement your Scripture listening.

KIDS
Help your children fall in love with God's Word from an early age. Dwell's kids content brings Scripture to life in a way that's engaging and age-appropriate for the whole family.

BUILD A LASTING HABIT
Growth in Christ doesn't happen by accident. Dwell's listening plans, daily reminders, and sleep mode make it easy to return to Scripture morning, night, and every moment in between.

- Sleep mode — fall asleep to the Word being read over you
- Scripture memorization with Repeat & Reflect
- Create and share personalized Scripture playlists
- 300+ curated Passages and 100+ themed Playlists to explore

"One of my favorite apps out there. Another way to immerse myself in God's word."
– Matt Chandler
"I can't begin to rave enough about Dwell and how formational it is."

TRY FREE FOR 7 DAYS
Get full access to everything Dwell has to offer — Audio Bible, Devotionals, Prayers, Audiobooks, Kids content, and more.

CIBC Caribbean My Rewards is an exclusive benefit for customers of participating banks. It is more than a loyalty program—it's a world of endless possibilities to earn, redeem and get unparalleled benefits on the go. 
CIBC Caribbean My Rewards is a 100%-digital experience like no other, offering a wide marketplace to redeem miles for travel, everyday purchases, recurring payments, and a lot more. It also allows for advanced capabilities like split payments, miles purchase and contactless payments among others, all integrated into a user-friendly, seamless solution.
Through the Miles Digital Card, your rewards become a digital currency (Miles) that allows you to shop for anything you want, whenever you want. To start doing so, simply add the Miles Digital Card to any major e-wallet (Google Pay, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, PayPal, etc.) and use it to complete payment transactions, either online or contactless in store.
With CIBC Caribbean My Rewards, you can now...
* Redeem your miles at 100+ million merchants worldwide, online or in store via contactless
* Redeem miles at over 28 million travel deals including airlines, hotels and car rentals. 
* Redeem your miles to travel flex, with 100% changeable reservations.
* Book flights with no seat restrictions or blackout dates
* Get instant funds directly on your Miles Digital Card for mishaps like flight delays, lost or delayed baggage, medical expenses and a lot more
* International medical assistance and COVID-19 protection 
* Up to 3X upperMiles for redeeming your miles on travel within CIBC Caribbean My Rewards
* Not enough miles to travel? Don't worry! Combine your miles with your credit card.
Got a question? CIBC Caribbean My Rewards is a 100% digital experience. Reach out to alle, our smart agent, and get answers 24/7 from the app or web, via WhatsApp, iMessage or Facebook Messenger.

bluejetty:00136532:ios.description:
Are you a fan of laid-back casual gaming? Do you seek a leisurely yet challenging pastime in sorting games? Dive into the enchanting world of "Sorting Match Puzzle" a thrilling sorting game powered by triple match mechanics. Immerse yourself in a dynamic experience where you can enjoy the fun of sorting snacks, drinks, fruits and unlocking a variety of 3D models.
With well-designed levels and millions of goods to sort, this game offers a delightful and accessible experience. The vibrant and vivid art style breathes vibrancy into the goods, making it not just a puzzle but a visual treat. Engage in Challenges mode for special experiences, gain stunning rewards, and unlock precious prizes. Enjoy an easy-to-play experience that effortlessly kills time and provides relaxation. This game serves as a brain training exercise, enhancing your arranging skills, time management abilities, and even contributing to an improved IQ score.
HOW TO PLAY: 
Embark on the challenge of matching goods through triple match mechanics in randomly arranged cabinets. Swiftly sort millions of items, unveiling a captivating and intuitive gameplay. Navigate well-designed levels with ease, making it accessible to players of all skill levels.
FEATURES: 
- Straightforward gameplay
- Engage in a vast array of well-designed puzzle levels, each offering a unique sorting challenge.
- Handy tips in Goods Match: Tackle tricky triple tile puzzles with abundant rewards like boosters and coins
- Brilliant and colorful realistic 3D items in various theme: beverages, canned food, fast food, snacks, toys,...

bluejetty:00174870:ios.summary:

FTA Search, the unofficial tool kit for Fast Track Auctions, provides a friendly user exper
bluejetty:00174870:ios.description:
Sometimes finding items on BidFTA can be difficult. However, with FTA Search, your days of scouring the auction pages for the best deals are over! 
FTA Search, the unofficial tool kit for Fast Track Auctions, provides a friendly user experience for searching, filtering, and following items on the BidFTA platform. 
FTA Search includes a full text search engine for searching the entire database of items available on BidFTA. You can search, filter by location, and sort by relevancy or items ending soonest. 
FTA Search also allows you to save items that you are interested in to your watchlist, or request a push notification so you don't miss out on a sweet deal.
--- Full list of features ---
• Powerful search features, exclude terms (-) or phrases ("") 
• See what items the current high bidder is winning.
• Get a sense of the average price similar items have sold for.
• Search for items across all locations, or filter by locations you are interested in.
• Filter by condition, filter by New, Open Box, or Damaged. 
• Browse items across the entire site, sorted by Lowest High Bid, Ending Soonest, or Newly Listed
• Get SMS notifications or Push Notifications when an Item you are interested in is about to end. 
• Bid on items using the in-app web browser, or open items in Safari.
• Save items to the App Watchlist, and use the app watchlist to keep track of item's you're interested in.
You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase.
• Auto-renewable subscription
• 1 year ($9.99) duration
• Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase
• Privacy policy and terms of use: https://www.bidft.auction/privacy

bluejetty:00018091:ios.name: LVCU Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00018091:ios.summary: At LVCU, we’re committed to being your partner as you define your financial future, and are continuously looking for ways to improve our members’ experience. Use our mobile app to check your account information, transfer money, deposit che
bluejetty:00018091:ios.description:
At LVCU, we’re committed to being your partner as you define your financial future, and are continuously looking for ways to improve our members’ experience. Use our mobile app to check your account information, transfer money, deposit cheques, pay bills and more – all from your iPhone or iPad! Plus you’ll have quick access to our branch contact information.
Features
• Login with your existing Online Banking ID and Password
• For secure and quick access, set-up Biometric Login or Facial Recognition
• View your account activity, balances and recent transactions
• Pay bills now or set them up for a future date
• View and edit upcoming scheduled bills and transfers
• Send money instantly with Interac e-Transfer®
• Transfer money between Lake View Credit Union accounts
• Quickly and securely deposit your cheques using your smartphone or tablet
• Search or use your current location to find nearby branches and ATM’s
• Display your balance at-a-glance without having to log in with QuickView
Benefits 
• It’s simple to use
• You can download it for free*
• It’s fully compatible with iPhone and iPad
• You can access our app using your existing online banking credentials
• You can use QuickView for quick access to your account information without having to log in
• Quick access options – Saved and Biometric Logins and Face ID
PERMISSIONS
In order to use the Lake View Credit Union Mobile App, you'll need to grant our app permission to access certain functions on your mobile phone, including:
• Full network access – Allows our app to connect to the Internet.
• Approximate location – Find our nearest branch or 'ding-free' ATM by allowing our app to access your phone's GPS.
• Take pictures and videos – Deposit cheques using Deposit Anywhere™ right from your mobile phone by allowing our app access to your phone camera.
• Access to your phone contacts – Get the utmost in convenience by allowing our app to access your list of contacts, that way you can send an Interac e-Transfer® to someone on your contact list without manually setting them up as a recipient in mobile banking.
Depending on your operating system, these permissions may be worded differently on your Apple™ device.
Access
Access is available to all members who currently use our online banking service. If you’re not a Lake View Credit Union member, no problem – contact any of our branches or visit us online at www.lakeviewcreditunion.com to open your membership and get set up with access right away. To login you’ll need your Member Number and Personal Access Code (PAC).
Use of the mobile app is subject to the terms and conditions found in our Lake View Credit Union Direct Services Agreements.

You will have to survive a horde of enemies. With the help of your amazing army, march forward. Count on your soldiers and merge the units to become more powerful in order to defeat the attackers. Get ready for warfare!

bluejetty:00127305:ios.description:
This app helps to remove the background of any picture of yours and maintain transparency with just few taps. 
Just touch where you want to remove. "Target" function removes the area of similar color automatically. 
The image which one maintaining transparency background can be used with other apps 
ex) Keynote. Pages, etc. 
#Cut Out Tools – Cut images (Zoom in to work for fine pixel-level accuracy) 
___#Erase/Restore : Erase/Restore the area you touched 
___#Target Area Auto remove tool (Area/Color) : Remove similar color area automatically 
___#Reverse tool : Reverse removed area 
#Crop – Crop your photos with 15 different presets feature quickly and easily. 
#Adjust Effect - 9 ADJUSTMENT tools (Smooth, brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, highlights, shadows, temperature, vignette) 
**”Smooth” - Smoothing image edge 
#Add Background Photo - Remove & Change your photo background 
#Full Resolution - Selecting size of output picture (HQ 3264 x 3264 pixel , Normal 1600 x 1600 pixel, LQ 800 x 600 pixel) 
#PNG/ JPEG File Selection - Selecting size of output picture (PNG_transparent background,JPEG_white background)

Creating Invoice - FreshBooks also offers easy and professional invoicing, allowing you to impress your clients with invoices that clearly show all the work you've done, and follow up with automated payment reminders if needed.

***Named a Top 25 App of 2025 by Apple***
Blossom is a free social investing app and social portfolio tracker that helps you track your stocks, ETFs, and dividends, follow real investor portfolios, and learn how to invest with confidence.
Join 500,000+ DIY investors building long-term wealth together through transparency, community, and education.
Whether you’re investing in dividend stocks, ETFs, or individual stocks, Blossom makes it easy to see what real investors are doing, track your portfolio in one place, and grow your financial knowledge - without hype or guesswork.
**Track Your Investment Portfolio (Automatically)
Connect your brokerage accounts and instantly view your entire investment portfolio in one clean dashboard. Blossom supports top brokers including Robinhood, Fidelity, Vanguard, Charles Schwab, Webull, Wealthsimple, Questrade, and more.
- Real-time portfolio tracking
- Beautiful asset allocation & pie charts
- One place for all your investments
**Dividend Tracker & Income Forecast
Know exactly how much dividend income your portfolio generates - now and in the future.
- Track dividends by stock & ETF
- Forecast monthly and annual dividend income
- See your passive income grow over time
Perfect for dividend investors and long-term wealth builders.
**Social Investing with Real Portfolios
Follow the verified portfolios and trades of over 500,000 investors, including top investing creators and educators.
See what real investors are:
- Buying
- Holding
- Earning in dividends
No screenshots. No “trust me” advice. Just transparency.
**Research Stocks & ETFs in One App
Build your watchlist and research stocks faster with key metrics all in one place.
- Dividends & yields
- Returns & performance
- Ratios & fundamentals
- Insights from real investors
Spend less time jumping between apps.
**Learn How to Invest (Beginner-Friendly)
New to investing? Blossom makes learning fun and simple.
- Duolingo-style investing lessons
- Daily stock & ETF trivia
- Built by trusted investing educators
Perfect for beginners and anyone leveling up their financial literacy.
**Earn While You Learn
Get rewarded with real money for completing short educational lessons on new ETFs and stocks.
Learn → Earn → Invest smarter.
**Deeper Portfolio Analysis (Blossom PRO)
Upgrade to Blossom PRO to unlock deeper insights, including:
- Geographic exposure
- Capital gains vs dividends
- Advanced portfolio breakdowns
- Professional-grade analytics

bluejetty:00177126:ios.description:
Get ready for the most unique tower defense game, where you set your defense strategy and rush into battle to claim victory!
Find amazing gaming experiences and exciting chapters filled with unique game units in this tower defense game. Rush through endless scenarios by arranging your towers and roads to defend your base against the waves of the enemy raid!
STRATEGY unites with LUCK
• Reveal the mega tower and assemble your Battle Deck according to your defense strategy, but which tower cards you will get during the battle is a matter of complete luck.
• Beat the enemy raid, level up, pick one of three random tower cards from your deck, and strengthen your defense power. Make wise decisions for the best strategy, as poor choices lead to defeat, and there is no way back!
Extend ROADS and LAND
• Path cards give you complete control over the enemy route to your base. Strike and conquer the enemy units before they even get close to your base. Your defense strength and strategic approach are the key to victory!
• Check out the tower’s abilities and stats, then place the paths accordingly. Arrange your battle strategy carefully to ensure victory! With thousands of unique defense strategy combinations at your command, the unique possibilities are endless!
VARIETY in Gameplay
• Dozens of characteristic maps, arenas, chapters, and tower units await you on your strategy to victory.
• Face diverse enemies, powerful bosses, air and ground units, and rush to beat them all.
• Build special tower units and Battle Deck alternatives to gain an advantage over the enemy raid.
• Upgrade your tower units, explore merge options, and use booster skills to rise above the raid and destroy your rivals!
• Join events and tournaments that help you to progress in the leaderboard and earn more trophies.
• Complete quests and rush to collect daily rewards to unlock unique awards.
Raid Rush is not just a tower defense game; it’s an exhilarating journey of choices, tactics, and chance. So, why wait? Dive in and forge your legend of defense through the thrilling rush!
The base is under attack and desperate for a hero like you to develop a strategy and lead the defense!
Play Raid Rush now and fight for the survival of your towers in this epic strategy game!
