bluejetty:00153905:ios.description:
Hello! If you're reading this you either really love Puzzmo or you are somehow undecided about our app. Let's be clear: you should download the app. We made it for you and it's free and it's really good! What do you have to lose?
Puzzmo is the center of the puzzle universe. You'll find fresh original games by brilliant designers like Zach Gage and new daily puzzles for modern classics like Cross|word, SpellTower, Flipart, Typeshift, Pile-Up Poker, Memoku, and more. You'll also find a little puzzle at the bottom of this AppStore description. Go on, scroll to the bottom.
NEW: MEMOKU
Inspired by the classic memory game, Memoku invites you to match pairs of numbers, but there's a twist – like Sudoku, no number can appear in the same row, column, or box twice. 
BONGO
Bongo challenges you to build a better board out of twenty five tiles, often picked on a theme by Puzzmo's friends, community members, and celebrity guests. There’s always a better board.
PILE-UP POKER
Pile-Up Poker is a twist on traditional poker where players build rows and columns of poker hands. The objective is to create the highest overall score by adding cards one by one to the gird, making strategic decisions along the way. 
FLIPART
Flipart is a modern twist on digital jigsaw puzzles. This free daily puzzle challenges you to rearrange Tetris-like shapes by tapping the pivot points so that none of the shapes overlap and they all fit within the border. Flipart puzzles are enjoyable for kids and adults alike!
TYPESHIFT
Typeshift is our free, daily captivating word puzzle game that challenges your vocabulary, spatial reasoning, and wit. Solve puzzles by shifting columns of letters like a combination lock to form words. Each puzzle is a fun brain-teaser chock full of both word search and strategy.
CROSS|WORD
Puzzmo crossword puzzles are for everyone. Some of the world’s top solvers compete daily for the fastest solve on Puzzmo, but that doesn’t mean we’re here to stump you. In fact if you’re new to crosswords or struggling complete a grid, we’re here to help. Only Puzzmo crosswords offer an optional, easier hint with every single clue. 
CUBECLEAR
Cube Clear is a word puzzle game where players spell words in a grid whose letters then disappear. Longer words score higher points, and adjacent tiles disappear after use, causing remaining tiles to tumble to the bottom of the grid. With only 36 letters, the challenge of Cube Clear is two-fold. Can you clear the board, and in how few words? 
WORDBIND
Wordbind is a directional anagram game that challenges you to discover new words hidden within the chosen words of the day. You can only key in letters from left to right, you’re allowed to skip letters, and you can use the same letter twice to find the perfect word. With each word you find, you rise the ranks on your way to Luminary status.
REALLY BAD CHESS
Aside from the small advantage white gains by making the first move, chess is a battle of wits between two competitors with the same pieces in the same positions. Puzzmo’s free daily Really Bad Chess game turns all of that “fairness” on its head. For example, you might have a huge material advantage with three queens while your computer opponent might have no queens and five rooks. The pieces may look random, but your advantage is carefully calculated!
SPELLTOWER
SpellTower is a two-dimensional grid of letters that looks like your typical word search puzzle. But unlike a traditional word search, you can change directions, cross your own path, go diagonal, and even spell backwards! This freedom of movement allows you to find more complex and challenging words, but this isn’t the only twist with SpellTower. As you use letters, they disappear from the grid, with the ultimate goal being a perfect, total clear of the entire board.
You found it! If you can solve this classic riddle, enter the answer at puzzmo.com/code
"Forward I’m heavy, backwards I’m not. What word am I?"
Happy puzzling!

bluejetty:00073739:ios.description:
Smart Pill ID: AI Pill Identifier, Drug Guide & Safety Tool
Confused by loose pills or need fast medication info? Smart Pill ID is your essential tool for instant, accurate pill identification and comprehensive drug information, powered by advanced Artificial Intelligence. Ensure your medication safety today!
Identify Pills Instantly Your Way:
 • Snap a Photo: Our AI analyzes pictures directly from your camera.
 • Use Gallery Images: Quickly identify pills from your saved photos.
 • Manual Entry: Search effectively using imprint codes, color, shape, and size.
 • Essential Free Information: For any identified drug, gain immediate access to core details:
 • Description: Understand the pill's appearance, composition, and purpose.
 • Side Effects: Learn about common potential adverse effects.
 • Basic Drug Information: Get insights into the medication's general use.
 • Potential Interactions: Perform initial checks for conflicts.
Unlock the Full Power with Premium – Your Comprehensive Medication Resource:
 • Unlimited Scans: Identify pills as often as you need, without restriction.
 • Unlimited Pill Saves: Keep a detailed history of all your identified medications.
 • Barcode Scanner: Instantly retrieve drug information directly from packaging barcodes.
 • Pill Counter: Easily track your doses and manage your medication supply.
 • Official Manufacturer Documents: Access source documentation from the drug makers.
 • Full FDA Drug Labels: Read complete, official drug labeling and safety information.
 • Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy focused, uninterrupted access to all features.
PLUS, dive deep into extensive prescription details including:
 • Directions: Clear instructions for optimal medication effectiveness.
 • Missed Dosage Instructions: Guidance on what to do if a dose is missed. 
 • Things to Avoid: Discover substances, activities, or circumstances to steer clear of.
 • Comprehensive Side Effects: In-depth information on potential side effects and their management.
 • Drug Interactions: Identify detailed possible interactions to avoid complications.
 • Further Information: Delve deeper into usage, precautions, and storage.
 • Indications & Usage: Understand precisely which conditions the medication treats.
 • Information for Nursing Mothers: Guidance on safety and effects during breastfeeding.
 • Pregnancy Information: Learn about impacts on pregnancy and fetal development.
 • Adverse Reactions: Explore a wider range of potential adverse reactions and their severity.
 • Clinical Pharmacology: Gain insights into the medication's mode of action and effects. 
 • Contraindications: Discover specific situations or conditions where the drug should not be used.
 • How Supplied: Detailed info on packaging, forms, and strengths available.
 • Laboratory Tests: Understand potential effects on lab test results.
 • Mechanism of Action: Get a deeper scientific understanding of how the medication works.
Enhance Your Medication Safety: With over 100,000 medication dispensing errors estimated yearly in the US alone, accuracy is vital. Smart Pill ID empowers patients, caregivers, doctors, nurses, and pharmacists to verify medications and access crucial information quickly.
Download Smart Pill ID now for confidence and peace of mind!
DISCLAIMER: Smart Pill Identifier is for informational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making medical decisions. Verify all results with a healthcare professional.

bluejetty:00026449:ios.description:
AI EDIT THAT EDITS LIKE A PROFESSIONAL VIDEO EDITOR
Built by Mirage™, Captions is an AI video generator and video editor that makes it easy to go from idea to ready-to-share content, no experience needed.
Get started by importing a video or generating engaging content from scratch using text to video. You can create an AI actor or upload a selfie to create a personal avatar, allowing you to produce polished footage of yourself without ever needing to record again. 
From there, skip the hours spent toggling and tweaking manual edits. Our AI video editor applies editorial discernment to cut scenes, overlay B-roll, and integrate sounds based on your video. Whether you polish your video with our AI edit feature or describe desired changes to our chat-based editor, Captions’ intuitive video maker makes it easy to bring your vision to life.
LET AI EDIT FOR YOU
- One-tap AI video editing: Transform raw footage into ready-to-post content instantly with curated effects and trending aesthetics.
- Edit like you text: Just describe your vision in plain language; our chat-based editor will apply effects, transitions, B-roll, and pacing per your direction.
CREATE A PERSONAL AI AVATAR
- AI Twin: Turn a single selfie into a high-quality video of yourself using our AI video generator.
- AI Actors: Generate talking videos with engaging AI avatars, giving you a digital on-brand spokesperson.
- Adjust looks: Change outfits, add objects, and switch backgrounds to feature the same AI avatar across unlimited videos.
 AI-POWERED EDITING TOOLS
- AI Denoise: Automatically remove background noise from talking videos.
- AI Zoom: Instantly add relevant zooms to your content.
- AI Scale: Quickly resize videos for whatever aspect ratio you need.
- AI Hashtags: Automatically generate video captions and hashtags.
- AI Teleprompter: Read directly from your script while recording in-app.
- Multiple AI models: Choose from 20+ models to generate music, sounds, and visuals.
CAPTIONS AND DUBBING
- AI Dubbing: Dub your content into 29 languages with just a tap of a button.
- AI Subtitles: Automatically generate accurate captions or subtitles in 91+ languages. You can choose specific fonts and colors too.
Captions, LLC (US) Developer

bluejetty:00070688:ios.description:
Searching for the ultimate word puzzle experience? Look no further! Word Town offers a unique twist on traditional brain games, combining satisfying word crush mechanics with relaxing gameplay and charming landscapes. Find hidden words, crush letter blocks, and travel around the world – all in one addictive game! Play offline anytime to train your brain, expand your vocabulary, and melt your stress away.
How to Play:
• Swipe & Connect: Swipe letters in any direction to form hidden words.
• Crush & Fall: Watch the letter blocks crush and disappear as words are found!
• Stack & Solve: New blocks fall from above, creating exciting new word combinations.
• Clear the Board: Find all the words to clear the puzzle board and win!
Why You’ll Love Word Town:
• Multiple Play Modes: Enjoy diverse challenges including Word Fall, Word Rise, Hidden Words, Word Blast, Grammar Quiz, and Spelling Quiz.
• Challenging & Relaxing: Hundreds of addictive word search puzzles to sharpen your mind.
• Travel the World: Solve brain puzzles to unlock beautiful city scenes and travel themes.
• Fun Events: Join the Daily Puzzle, Treasure Hunt, and Undersea Party to win big rewards.
• Play Anywhere: 100% free to play offline – no internet or Wi-Fi needed!
Game Highlights:
• Easy to Pick Up: Intuitive swipe controls perfect for puzzle fans of all ages.
• Live Competition: Compete with friends and family on the real-time leaderboard.
• Abundant Rewards: Collect trophies, daily bonuses, and hidden surprises as you progress.
Whether you are a fan of anagrams, spelling quizzes, or relaxing block puzzles, Word Town is your perfect fit. Brought to you by the maker of hit games like Word Serenity, Word Carnival, Word Search Pop, Word Tile Puzzle, and Word Blast, this game will quickly turn you into a word puzzle pro!
Have feedback or suggestions?
Email: support@histudiogames.com
Terms of Service: http://www.histudiogames.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: http://www.histudiogames.com/privacy/

Designed for applicants, families, and professionals managi
bluejetty:00152055:ios.description:
MigraUSA Case Tracker is the tool for following immigration processes in the United States. Check the status of your USCIS and immigration court (EOIR) cases whenever you need to.
Designed for applicants, families, and professionals managing Green Card applications, work permits (EAD), asylum, TPS, naturalization, and visas.
Available in Spanish, English, Haitian Creole, Portuguese, French, and Chinese.
USCIS CASE TRACKING
Enter your receipt number (EAC, IOE, LIN, MSC, NBC, SRC, or WAC) and get the current status of your petition.
IMMIGRATION COURT (EOIR)
Use your A-Number to check the details of your court proceedings: hearing dates, assigned judge, and case status.
JUDGE STATISTICS
See the asylum decisions of the judge assigned to your court and compare them with the national average, based on public data.
STATISTICS AND PROCESSING TIMES
Approvals, denials, pending cases, and trends by form, plus published processing times. Aggregate public data: general reference, not an individual prediction.
CIVICS TEST
Practice the civics test questions with flashcards and quizzes.
PRIVACY BY DESIGN

bluejetty:00156279:ios.description:
Mormon Women for Ethical Government (MWEG) is a nonprofit, faith-based organization committed to advocating for ethical government and empowering women as peacemakers and engaged citizens. We are guided by our four core principles: faithful, nonpartisan, peaceful, and proactive. We would love to have you join us!
MWEG Central is our official community space where we gather together to build a more peaceful, just, and ethical world. Here you will have the opportunity to connect with principled women from across the nation and the political spectrum. We are working together to build peace in our communities, learn how to affect change, and become more civically engaged. Our shared goals are to help build the Beloved Community and ensure that our democracy is healthy and strong. 
This community is warm, supportive and empowering. Here you will have the opportunity to:
- Connect with other MWEG members — including in local chapters
- Discuss difficult issues in a respectful environment, where truth is prioritized. We do hard conversations well
- Access tools and resources that will help you build peacemaking, media literacy, and civic engagement skills
- Attend virtual events
- and more!
If you care about protecting democracy, the environment and sustainability, rooting out racism, fair and compassionate policies for immigrants and refugees, and supporting children and families, we have spaces where your small acts can help make a big impact. You don’t have to do much to help us move things forward. 
MWEG gives our members a new, emotionally supportive, and healthy way to be civically engaged. If you would like to participate in the political process but either don’t know how or are anxious about becoming embroiled in negative interactions, this is the place for you. We do politics in a whole new way. Join us!

Any content or opinions expressed, implied, or included in or with the services offered by MWEG™ are solely those of MWEG™ and not those of Intellectual Reserve, Inc. or The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

bluejetty:00160356:ios.name: Voice Notebook - audio to text
bluejetty:00160356:ios.summary:
The application enables continuous voice input and the transcription of audio files. Voice input can also be saved to a file for further processing.
For most languages and devices, the application operates offline, without requiring an i
bluejetty:00160356:ios.description:
The application enables continuous voice input and the transcription of audio files. Voice input can also be saved to a file for further processing.
For most languages and devices, the application operates offline, without requiring an internet connection. It leverages built-in iOS capabilities to convert speech into text. Voice input does not require the use of the keyboard, and there is no time limit on input.
The application offers three modes for transcribing audio files: a standard mode and two accelerated modes (available for devices running iOS 26 or later).
The application can read text aloud and generate audio files using text-to-speech (TTS) technology, with customizable voice and speech rate settings. Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) can be used within the source text.
There are two modes for voice-based text entry: dictation and speech-to-text. The speech-to-text mode is designed for real-time recording of meetings, while the dictation mode is intended for voice-based editing and text correction. In dictation mode, you can switch languages without interrupting the dictation process.
Text entered via voice can be saved as a file or shared with other applications. Note files are stored in a folder on the device and remain accessible to the user. The list of notes can be sorted by date or alphabetically.
A backup feature for notes is also included.
When transcribing audio files, timestamps can be inserted, and the resulting transcript can be exported into a format compatible with YouTube subtitles. To facilitate transcript correction, a playback mode is available that highlights the timestamps of the sentences currently being spoken.
For devices running iOS 16 or later, an auto-punctuation feature is available for supported languages.
For devices running iOS 17 or later, users can create custom dictionaries, allowing for the voice input of words or phrases that might not be recognized under standard settings. There is no limit to the number of custom dictionaries that can be created. For devices running iOS 16 or later, a shortcut has been implemented to create a new note and launch speech recognition; this shortcut can be triggered via Siri.
An Apple Watch app is included, allowing you to create both audio and text notes using your voice, which then sync with the main application.
An option to print notes is available.
Dark mode is supported.
The Premium tier removes advertisements, eliminates length limits for transcribed files, adds Bluetooth support, and enables an "always-on" screen mode. It also removes text length restrictions when generating audio files via text-to-speech synthesis and unlocks the "Open" button on the user dictionary page.
Terms of use can be found at: https://voicenotebook.com/ru/ios/terms/

Welcome to Hubb!
Here, you will enter a vibrant and creative community. Whether you are seeking fresh ideas or hoping to meet like-minded friends, we look forward to embarking on an exciting adventure together with you. Thank you for joining us, and let’s create unforgettable moments and beautiful memories together!
Hubb Hiking Assistant is an all-in-one toolkit and community for outdoor hikers. It combines AI route and gear advice, real-time team formation and group chat, map tracking, hiking journals and video sharing, technique learning, rankings, and a follow network—helping you explore the outdoors more safely, professionally, and enjoyably.
Whether it’s your first trail or your hundredth, Hubb is your pocket companion and journal: plan smart before departure, stay connected and protected on the way, and capture your highlights when you return.
Key Features
AI Hiking Advisor: Get route suggestions, gear checklists, and risk alerts based on your destination and conditions—answers on demand.
Maps & Teams: Browse routes and groups on the map, request to join, post team notices, and coordinate with location-aware updates.
Group & Private Chats: Team group chats and DMs with image and video support for efficient collaboration.
Emergency SOS: One-tap help to quickly share your status and location (with permission).
Hiking Journals: Rich photo/video logs with drafts and publishing to memorialize every journey.
Tips & Know-How: A library of techniques, gear guidance, and route insights for quick reference.
Videos & Galleries: Discover quality short hiking videos and photos for inspiration and planning.
Follows & Fans: Follow fellow hikers, chat, and build your hiking social circle.
Leaderboards: Points and activity rankings to surface top hikers and standout routes.
Profile: Showcase your tracks, journals, media, and milestones.
Who It’s For
New hikers taking their first steps
Outdoor lovers who enjoy recording and sharing
Team players who need coordination and comms
Advanced hikers focused on safety and efficiency

bluejetty:00135337:ios.description:
# Apple Design Awards Finalist
# Featured on the App Store
# Great on iOS 26
# App of the Day
# "Apps We Love" by Apple
Harness the Power of the Sun with Sunlitt:
your all-in-one tool for tracking the sun’s position, movements, and shadows, anywhere and anytime.
→ Follow the Sun’s Path and Position
Access precise, up-to-the-minute sun tracking data tailored to your location, anytime—even without an internet connection.
→ Analyze Sunlight and Shadows
Discover how sunlight interacts with shadows. Perfect for architects, photographers, and outdoor enthusiasts.
→ Augmented Reality - AR
See the sun’s path in your environment and use the Monolitt to visualize real-time shadow movement directly in your scene.
→ Solar Events Times
Stay on top of important solar events like sunrise, sunset, golden hour, blue hour, solstices, and equinoxes with detailed timing information.
→ Map
Dive deeper with powerful tools like the Shadow Map and view the Sun’s Path over terrain or satellite imagery for a thorough visual analysis.
→ Landform Shadows
See how hills, mountains, and valleys affect sunlight by casting real shadows on the 3D map. PRO required.
→ Monolitt Mode
Enjoy a simple yet engaging sun-tracking tool, perfect for daily tasks like finding a good parking spot, selecting a sunny picnic area, or getting the perfect tan!
Designed for creators & explorers, Sunlitt works seamlessly offline, syncs across all your devices, and offers:
 • Support for Apple Watch, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro
 • Widgets for Lock & Home Screen
 • Notifications & Live Activities
 • App Intents and Shortcuts
 • Free access to essential sun-tracking features
Unlock even more with Sunlitt PRO:
Change the date, get twilight details, azimuth, altitude, shadow ratio, weather forecasts, shadows in AR, landform shadows and much more.
Whether you’re a photographer, real estate professional, designer, or outdoor enthusiast, Sunlitt is your ultimate tool for tracking the sun’s journey in the sky.
Got feedback?
We’d love to hear from you! Reach us at hello@sunlitt.app
Loving Sunlitt?
Leave a review and share the love!

Everyone loves being in the corner
Go Kawaii crazy with the latest characters from the creators of Rilakkuma. Join Shirokuma, Tonkatsu and Neko for some amazing match-4 fun.

The perfectly chilled out puzzle game wherever you are, in the Metro, cat café, or even at the karaoke bar!
With quirky personalities, cute stories and even cuter animations, you’ll be in love at first sight. 
*MEET YOUR NEW BUDDIES*
Shirokuma – From the frozen north. All he wants is a hot tea in the corner
Tonkatsu – A pork cutlet that’s 99% fat. What is the 1%? Well… you see that cute little nose?
Neko – The cutest cat ever. She loves sharpening her claws in the corner
Furoshiki – A traditional Japanese wrapping cloth, perfect for cold bears
Tapioca – Busy little leftovers from bubble tea. They love rolling into the corner
Hokori – Just so happy to be in the corner with the other Sumikko gurashi
Join Sumikko gurashi and their puzzling ways for some all-new match-4 fun.

bluejetty:00036552:ios.description:
Tri MyRide –The most efficient way to get to BART!
Tri MyRide is an on-demand ride-sharing service operated by Tri Delta Transit. Use Tri MyRide for safe, efficient, and affordable travel to Antioch or Pittsburg/Bay Point BART as well as popular shopping destinations. Tri MyRide is convenient and easy to use - simply use the app to select your pick-up and drop-off points and a vehicle will meet you at a nearby corner! 
How much does a Tri MyRide cost?
$2 flat fare
When can I travel?
Tri MyRide operates Monday to Friday, 5 am – 9 pm.
How long will I wait?
You will always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking. Once Tri MyRide is on route to pick you up you can track your ride in real-time using the app. 
How many passengers will I share a vehicle with?
The number of passengers varies based on demand. 
Love our app? Please rate us! 
Questions? Email us at TriMyRide@eccta.org

Marham
bluejetty:00146615:ios.description:
Marham is your one-stop solution to find the right doctors nationwide, in your locality and also, the best option to Book Appointment and consult a doctor through Online Consultation. Get assistance in your ailing healthcare needs.
Marham is the Digital Healthcare platform for the people of Pakistan. It is designed to address the Medical and Health issues posed to patients and doctors. It can help you to find Doctors, Physicians, and Consultants around you. 
Ensuring the best healthcare service for the people of Pakistan by connecting Doctors & Patients, now through telemedicine as well.
Marham's most distinctive features include:
Book Appointment Anytime From Anywhere
Online Consultations With The Best Doctors Nationwide
Need Emergency Help? Use our 'Call Doctor Now' Service
*Avail these services without any additional charges
For Patients:
Enables you to find doctors through specialty, area, ratings, gender, fee, and cities.
Search doctors by their name or hospitals they practice in.
Lets you find consultants through the diseases they deal with.
Marham Forum allows you to post any health-related query and receive instant help from the relevant doctor.
Choose a doctor with the help of their qualification, degrees, experience, fee, appointment number, and times mentioned on their profile.
Integrated maps on MARHAM's app can help you find the address to the doctors' clinics.
To improve the healthcare ecosystem, Marham encourages people to share their feedback about doctors so that others can get timely benefitted of it
For Doctors:
If you are a doctor you can get yourself registered with MARHAM and grow your practice.
Keep your profile updated to get more patients
Online Consultations:
Marham not only helps you to find the right doctor in your area but it also enables you to talk to your doctor while sitting back at your home.
Through MARHAM's mobile app, you can now talk to your doctor through audio and video consultation anytime and anywhere you want to.
Call Doctor Now:
Through MARHAM's call doctor now feature, you can call on the provided number and get immediately redirected to the doctor without any waiting time.
The difference between online audio/video consultation is that for online consultation, you'll need to request time from the doctors. Whereas through our 'Call Doctor Now' service, you can talk to a doctor without any wait.
You can find Doctors of over 80+ Specialities from all around Pakistan. Moreover, you can search them according to gender, area, fee, and cities.
Here are some of the top viewed specialties you can find on MARHAM - Find A Doctor
Gynaecology
Dermatology
Sexology
Psychiatry
Moreover, you can also find these top-rated hospitals on MARHAM:
Hameed Latif Hospital
Doctors Hospital
Hashmanis Hospital
Omi Hospital
Quaid-e-Azam International Hospital
Shifa International Hospital
Maroof International Hospital
Having ear pain and confused about what to do? You can find the best ENT Specialist through Marham's mobile app.
In the times of viral infection, you can look up to Marham and find the top General Physicians around you and consult them through your mobile phone without waiting anymore.
Suffering from extreme hair fall? Marham mobile app can help you connect to the Best Dermatologist around you.
Be it liver transplant, kidney issues, or reconstructive surgeries Marham's mobile app is your one-stop solution to look for the top nephrologists, liver specialists, and cosmetic surgeons for you!
Privacy and Security Through Marham:
While booking an appointment with Marham, either a video consultation or in-person consultation, your privacy and security is our first priority. The patient's information and personal details are not disclosed to anyone except Marham.
App Range and Availability:
All over Pakistan

bluejetty:00023241:ios.summary: Equalizer+ is an all-in-one music player - equalizer - bass booster that offers brilliant sound quality, automatically optimized depending on the headphones used. Access your entire music library: iTunes, Google Drive, and Dropbox with offl
bluejetty:00023241:ios.description:
Equalizer+ is an all-in-one music player - equalizer - bass booster that offers brilliant sound quality, automatically optimized depending on the headphones used. Access your entire music library: iTunes, Google Drive, and Dropbox with offline mode - no wifi needed! 
Quality-focused, Equalizer+ makes it possible for you to mix, edit and customize the sound of your tracks to ensure an optimal music listening experience. Adjust songs that have too much or too little highs and lows, boost your bass to give more depth to your tracks, play your playlists like a DJ with the special DJ transitions, watch your sound pulse to the beat of the music...you control the sound!
ACCESS ALL YOUR FAVORITE TRACKS
- cloud storages access: Dropbox, Google Drive & iCloud 
- offline mode: no internet or WiFi needed 
- local music: all your iTunes tracks will automatically appear on Equalizer+
- import your iTunes playlists or directly create new ones on Equalizer+
- iTunes shared folder access: transfer your tracks between your computer and your device without having to synchronize with iTunes
- contextual search feature: gives results sorted by songs, artists, albums, or playlists
THE BEST ALL-IN-ONE MUSIC PLAYER
- 7-band equalizer (from bass to high) to tailor your songs to your taste
- 10 equalizer presets based on music genres (Flat, Pop, Rock, Electro, Dance, R&B, Hip hop, Jazz, Acoustic, Classical)
- all major audio formats supported: mp3, FLAC...
- possibility to save and edit your own custom presets 
- powerful bass booster: control the depth of your tracks
- spectral representation of the sound: watch your sound pulse to the beat of the music thanks to awesome visualizers (Spectrum is FREE - other visualizers available in the premium version)
- Airplay compatibility: dedicated view for the visualizers, watch your sound move on your tv!
- Fade (DJ mode): access 6 predefined transition modes, and choose when to trigger the next track
- queue system: prepare your tracklist in advance
- 3-status 'repeat' function: repeat 1 song, repeat a whole playlist, no repetition
- shuffle function: play your songs in random mode
- music progression bar: easy navigation within your music
- iPad special landscape mode
- Sleep Timer: schedule the music stop, Equalizer+ will automatically stop when needed
MUSIC SOURCES INFORMATION
- Some tracks cannot be played for copyright reasons. It is the case for DRM-Protected tracks from the Apple Music application or some older tracks purchased on the iTunes Store with DRM protection.
- Equalizer+ can not access tracks from Spotify, Deezer or other streaming services.
The Pro subscription allows you to access all the present and upcoming Pro features such as the Bass Booster effect, the spectral representation catalog, the Pro DJ transition catalog. Pro subscribers can also access to unlimited playlists.
ABOUT EQUALIZER+

bluejetty:00187363:ios.description:

Pay once. No subscription. No monthly fee.
# ANNOTATE & EDIT PDFs
- Work directly inside your PDF.
- Highlight important text, draw, add comments, annotate pages and edit PDF content without recreating the entire document.
# SCAN ANY DOCUMENT
- Turn your iPhone or iPad into a portable document scanner.
- Scan receipts, contracts, notes, forms and multi-page documents in seconds. Automatic edge detection helps create clean, professional-looking PDFs without needing a separate scanner.
# OCR — EXTRACT TEXT FROM IMAGES
- Need text from a photo, scanned document or handwritten document?
- OCR can recognize and extract text from images, scanned documents, handwritten documents and image-based PDFs.
- Copy, search or work with the extracted text without typing everything again.
# MERGE & SPLIT PDFs
- Organize PDF pages exactly the way you need.
- Combine multiple PDF files into a single document, or split a large PDF into smaller files. Great for reports, invoices, forms and document collections.
# SIGN DOCUMENTS
- Sign PDFs directly on your iPhone or iPad.
- No printing, signing and scanning again. Simply open your document, add your signature and share the completed PDF.
# CONVERT FILES TO PDF — OR BACK AGAIN
- Quickly convert documents between popular formats:
- Word to PDF
- PDF to Word
- Excel to PDF
- PDF to Excel
- PowerPoint to PDF
- PDF to PowerPoint
- JPG to PDF
- PDF to JPG
- Web Page to PDF
- PDF to Text
- PDF to HTML
- PDF to RTF
Keep your documents in the format you actually need.
# COMPRESS PDFs
- Large PDF taking too much space?
- Reduce PDF file size to make documents easier to email, share, upload or store while maintaining useful document quality.
# PROTECT, UNLOCK & WATERMARK PDFs
- Keep sensitive documents protected.
- Add password protection to PDFs, unlock files you have permission to access, and add watermarks to help protect your work.
# CHAT TO PDF
- Export WhatsApp chats as beautifully formatted PDFs or interactive HTML.
- Choose from WhatsApp-style or clean document layouts, personalize with themes, search messages, jump between months, and view shared media easily.
- Perfect for saving memories, keeping records, and archiving important conversations.
# ROTATE & CROP PDF PAGES
- Fix poorly oriented or badly cropped pages in seconds.
- Rotate pages with a tap, remove unwanted margins, or crop multiple pages to create a cleaner document.
# MORE PDF TOOLS
- PDF Export includes many additional tools for everyday document work, including:
- Blank PDF editor
- Web to PDF
- Clipboard to PDF
- Add page numbers
- Extract images
- Repair PDFs
- Transcribe content
- Send fax
And more
TRY BEFORE YOU BUY
See how the tools work before purchasing.
Import your own file for a trial, or use the built-in sample document anytime to explore available features.
# WHY PDF EXPORT?
- 30+ PDF tools in one app
- One-time purchase — no subscription
- Scan, edit, sign and convert documents
- Export WhatsApp chats to PDF or interactive HTML
- Designed for iPhone and iPad

bluejetty:00063344:ios.description:
Welcome to Jiggy!
Where your dream to become a star becomes true. Or, at least, you can try to fake it with your friends on social media and have fun!
Discover our always-up-to-date catalog of clips and movies and start swapping your face with top-class actors and VIPs.
Decide whether you want to be the protagonist of an action movie, a sexy dancer, a superhero, a top model on a magazine cover, a spooky maniac in a horror movie, a romantic lover of your favorite drama series, a... Well, you can be whoever you want here!
- How do I do that?
It's so simple that even your grandma can use it.
Take a selfie or upload it from your gallery, choose a fancy clip, and that's it. In a few seconds, you're a star!
- What's next?
Pick some friends you want to bother and share your clips as videos or GIFs. They'll hate you because of the laugh you'll cause them at work.
Guess what? You can also share them on social media. Just think about how fun your TikToks and Instagram Stories would be. You're going to be much more famous than the President!
Ok, maybe not that famous... But still popular enough to receive gifts from fashion companies.
- How's it possible?
That's the hard part, but it's on us. We've hired a bunch of ultra nerds, constantly typing super fast on their keyboards to take care of our Artificial Intelligence. Which takes advantage of a Neural Network, that's basically a very sophisticated algorithm that does the face morphing stuff. Look, guys, I don't understand a single word of what they're doing, but I know for sure they're the best at doing it.
- Where do my photos go?
In space! Naaah, I'm just joking.
We care about your privacy, and we do NOT collect any personal data from them. We don't even want your email address or phone number.
Anyway, if you really want to know more about how we manage your data, check the links below.
Privacy Policy: https://www.facebrity.app/privacy-policy.pdf
Terms and Conditions: https://www.facebrity.app/terms-and-conditions.pdf
- Do I have to pay?
Yes, of course, you have to pay. Try asking not to pay in a restaurant.
We offer different tiers of in-app subscriptions that allow you to access all the premium content. And yes, we do offer promos, but you've to activate notifications to receive them.
Most of the money goes to those nerds I've mentioned before. We tried paying them with Cheetos, but it didn't work.

- Open a bank account with your ITIN, passport, consular ID, or SSN.

- Use your money safely online and in person.
COMPLETELY SECURE
- Visa’s zero liability policy protects all unauthorized purchases.
- Two-factor authentication and biometric security.
OPENING AN ACCOUNT IS EASY
- Open a Seis account directly from your phone.
- In just 3 minutes.
SEIS MEMBERSHIPS
Seis Member: $6/month or $0 when you spend > $1,500 with your Seis debit or credit card
Members get a Visa debit card with fraud protection, a U.S. bank account, 1% cashback at McDonald’s, Netflix, Starbucks and others (on up to $500 in spend), $2,000 in daily ATM withdrawals, and much more!
Plus Member: $10/month or $4 when you spend > $1,500 with your Seis debit or credit card
Everything in Seis Member plus Seis Silver Secured Credit Card, 1 additional debit card, kids’ accounts (coming soon), 1% cashback up to $1,000.
Premium Member: $15.95/month or $9.95 when you spend > $1,500 with your Seis debit or credit card. Everything in Plus Member plus 1 free cash deposit, 1 out-of-network ATM withdrawal with no fee, VIP customer support, 1% cashback up to $2,000 per month.
DISCLOSURES: 
*Seis is not a bank. Credit services offered by Lead Bank, Member FDIC. Seis Silver Credit Card, is issued by Lead Bank. Subject to credit eligibility requirements. Direct Deposit requirement applies to the external deposit account that is connected for underwriting. Not available in all states; see website for details. The Seis Silver Credit Card is offered to Seis Plus and Premium Members.
Seis is a financial technology company and is not a bank insured by the FDIC. Banking services are provided by Thread Bank, a member of the FDIC. FDIC deposit insurance covers the failure of an insured bank. The Seis Visa debit card is issued by Thread Bank, a member of the FDIC, under a license from Visa U.S.A. Let yourself learn new and exciting skills around the home for when you move out with this learning game. Here you will learn two new and important skills, washing and cooking. First you can cook a cake ready for eating by choosing and mixing the ingredients together ready for baking. Once the cooking is done you can then move on to washing the clothes by loading the washing machine, adding the soap powder and hanging them out to dry. Let yourself be ready for the big world with this washing and cooking game. 

Features – Cooking 

Learn new cooking skills by creating a yummy cake from real ingredients. 
Mix your ingredients together to make your cake mixture. 
Bake your cake and decorate it ready for eating by you, your parents and your friends. 

Features – Clothes Washing 

Learn new skills by learning how to wash the clothes properly. 
Load the washing machine and add the soap power ready for washing. 
Watch the clothes go round and round before hanging them out to dry on hangers.

bluejetty:00087413:ios.description:
Кампус — приложение №1 для студентов всех вузов и колледжей. Расписание занятий, оценки преподавателей, курсы, подработка и студенческое общение — всё в одном месте.
1. Расписание
Актуальное расписание пар твоего вуза или колледжа всегда под рукой. Добавляй заметки к занятиям, смотри изменения, не пропускай пары, зачёты и экзамены. Удобный виджет — прямо на экране телефона.
2. Все вузы и ссузы
Мы подключили сотни университетов, институтов, техникумов и колледжей по всей России, СНГ и Бразилии. Найди своё учебное заведение и группу за пару секунд.
3. Курсы и материалы
Готовься к сессии и экзаменам: курсы, методички и полезные материалы для учёбы — всё собрано в приложении.
4. Подслушано
Социальная сеть и чат твоего учебного заведения: делись историями, общайся с одногруппниками, знакомься, ставь лайки и будь в курсе всего, что происходит в универе.
5. Оценки преподавателей
Читай отзывы других студентов о преподавателях и оставляй свои — выбирай, к кому идти на пары и как готовиться к сессии.
6. Подработка и стажировки
Вакансии и подработка для студентов, стажировки и первая работа. Собери резюме с нашим ИИ-агентом и откликайся прямо в приложении.
7. Скидки и акции
Эксклюзивные предложения от партнёров специально для студентов.
Почему Кампус:
— Бесплатно и удобно
— Обновления каждую неделю
— Подходит студентам университетов, институтов, колледжей и техникумов
— Множество образовательных материалов
— Постоянно новые вакансии и подработки — даже для тех, кто без опыта
— Более 2 200 000 скачиваний

Guided walking tours of Metropolitan Museum of Art without needing internet access or GPS! All offline and on your phone with audio guides! Forget the maps, we guide you completely by photos in an innovative concept.
Visit Metropolitan Museum of Art at your own pace without Internet connection and explore the best places of interest with our different walking itineraries, created by our passionate Tourblinkers, instagrammers, bloggers and local inhabitants, visiting:
We give you all the important travel information to get around Metropolitan Museum of Art, which streets to take during your walking tour, and ensure you have a wonderful time traveling in Metropolitan Museum of Art, the city of lights.
A unique application to walk and visit Metropolitan Museum of Art! Like a freetour but with your phone.
With our itineraries or offline tours and audio guides, you can enjoy the city of Metropolitan Museum of Art at your own pace and experience the best that the city has to offer.
FREE TRAVEL INFORMATION AND QUALITY
Did you know that…. Metropolitan Museum of Art is one of the most visited cities in the world and has a very rich history! Our team at Tourblink is made up of professional tour guides and passionate locals who know what questions you may have and what you want to see during your trip to Metropolitan Museum of Art. All the information in the application is concise, useful, fun and easy to understand. And free! All points of interest contain information and free audio guide with the standard voice of your phone, and with the paid itineraries you can access to the voice of our tourblinkers.
- Madame X
- Madonna and Child
- Bain a la Grenouillere
- The Harvesters
- Study of a Young Woman
- The bridge over a Pond of Water Lilies
- The Death of Socrates
- View of Toledo
APPLICATION WITHOUT CONNECTION AND WITHOUT GPS
No data or connection, no problem! You can visit the city of Metropolitan Museum of Art and get all the practical information offline without roaming charges. Tourblink specializes in walking tours inspired by freetours available offline through images. Without maps, we guide you in the most intuitive way possible and you will not get lost.
PAID ROUTES OR ITINERARIES
We have created different tours or itineraries or routes of the city so you can explore Metropolitan Museum of Art at your own pace and according to your own schedule. At low cost, so that everyone can enjoy!
Do not know exactly how to optimize your time? Where do I start? We propose hourly itineraries to enjoy the museum or the city as much as you can! You will feel like a tour, but on your own and at your own pace. The audioguides will give you the information to understand what you see.

City Cabs Kitchener i
bluejetty:00093829:ios.description:
City Cabs Kitchener is a leading provider of Taxi services in Kitchener, Ontario Canada. We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free City Cabs application.
City Cabs Kitchener is a provider of taxicab services in Kitchener, Ontario, Canada.
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free City Cabs Kitchener application.
Key Features of the City Cabs Kitchener application include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call City Cabs Kitchener with the push of a button
To begin using the City Cabs Kitchener application today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip 
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The City Cabs Kitchener application retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.
Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the City Cabs Kitchener application or calling us at +1(519) 747-7777. 
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the City Cabs Kitchener application in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00114428:android.description:
When the square grid of traditional match games meets the dynamic hexagonal structure, a mind-blowing fingertip adventure begins—Hexagon Sort Crush redefines the fun boundaries of casual puzzle games with its unique honeycomb layout, stunning visual effects, and progressively challenging strategic gameplay. Whether you’re looking for quick stress relief during fragmented time or immersive high-score chasing, this game lets you embrace pure joy and a sense of fulfillment amid the collision of colors and geometry.
Boasting hundreds of meticulously designed levels, the difficulty escalates smoothly from beginner to master, with a scientifically calibrated drop in clearance rates. It never intimidates new players while still offering seasoned gamers the thrill of overcoming challenges. No rushed countdowns, no complicated task constraints—you can plan your moves at your own pace. Whether it’s a short relaxation during your commute or a stress-relieving moment before bed, slide your fingertips to watch life’s fatigue and anxiety fade away along with the blocks !

1. Unlock and activate your cards, both the holder and additional ones.
2. View your Esfera balance and statement.
3. Make inquiries and manage your card limit and extras.
4. Enable your cards for use abroad, by continent.
5. See your latest purchases, in real time.
6. See the details of your purchases, such as the category of the establishment, whether you spent on credit or debit, whether you purchased online, among others.
7. Check the card status on the Summary screen.
8. Request an additional card.
9. Consult and redeem Rewards (exclusive for the Reward Card).
10. Recharge your cell phone.
To manage your invoice at any time:
1. View your latest invoices in a graph.
2. Receive notifications about your invoice: closing, due date and possible delay.
3. Register your invoice by email.
4. Pay your invoice in installments.
5. Request a 2nd copy of the invoice via email or PDF.
6. Register the invoice in automatic debit (exclusive for account holders).
7. Copy the barcode for invoice payment.
8. Check the best shopping day.
To make purchases and transactions safely:
1. Generate your card online for online purchases.
2. Temporarily block your cards for purchases in physical and/or virtual stores.
3. Block the card in case of loss or theft and request a new one.
4. Check the card's password and security key.
5. Dispute unrecognized transactions
To make payments more easily:
1. Pay the card bill (exclusive for account holders).
2. Pay bills (exclusive for non-account holders, who only have a Santander credit card).
Not yet a customer?
Through Way you can also apply for a credit card.

bluejetty:00147504:ios.description:
LoJack helps keep you and your loved ones safe behind the wheel. Get speed, low battery, and GeoFence entry / exit alerts, all from the convenience of your phone. Find and recover your car using real-time GPS tracking.
Key Features:
• Real-Time GPS Tracking – Know where your vehicle is at all times
• Stolen Vehicle Recovery – Contact our concierge service 24x7. We will work with law enforcement directly to recover your vehicle.
• Track My SVR – Create a live tracking link you can share with authorized law enforcement officers. This link allows viewers to see your vehicle’s movement updates as they happen.
• Speed Alerts – Set a speed limit and get notified when car exceeds a designated safe speed. Great for helping new drivers be safe.
• Low Battery Alerts – Monitor battery status to proactively avoid being stranded
• GeoFences – Set up a location boundary and receive an alert when the GeoFence is crossed
• Multi-Vehicle Support – For LoJack families with multiple connected LoJack vehicles, you can add up to five vehicles in one account.
• Vehicle Recalls - LoJack will alert you regarding any potential safety recalls on your vehicle.
RENEWAL SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS:
Eligible LoJack subscribers will have the option to renew their LoJack subscription from within the LoJack app. Not all subscribers will have this option. Renewing LoJack continues access to our current feature set and access to future updates from LoJack. All subscriptions are paid in full for 12 months and set to renew annually.
PAYMENT AND AUTOMATIC RENEWAL TERMS:
IF YOU RENEW TO THE LOJACK VIA THIS APP, PAYMENT WILL BE CHARGED BY APPLE TO YOUR APPLE ID ACCOUNT AT CONFIRMATION OF PURCHASE. YOUR APPLE ID ACCOUNT WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY CHARGED FOR RENEWAL AT THE APPLICABLE RATE SHOWN TO YOU AT THE TIME OF SUBSCRIPTION EVERY CALENDAR MONTH (FOR MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTIONS) OR EVERY YEAR (FOR ANNUAL SUBSCRIPTIONS) WITHIN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO THE END OF THE CURRENT BILLING PERIOD. YOU WILL BE CHARGED IN ADVANCE. YOUR SUBSCRIPTION WILL AUTOMATICALLY RENEW EACH MONTH OR YEAR UNLESS IT IS CANCELED AT LEAST 24-HOURS BEFORE THE END OF THE CURRENT PERIOD. TO CANCEL, PLEASE TURN OFF AUTO-RENEW AT LEAST 24-HOURS BEFORE THE END OF THE CURRENT PERIOD. YOU CAN TURN OFF AUTO-RENEW AT ANY TIME FROM YOUR ITUNES ACCOUNT SETTINGS. CANCELATION TAKES EFFECT AT THE END OF THE CURRENT BILLING PERIOD.
BY DOWNLOADING THE LOJACK APP, you agree to:
• The automatic renewal terms stated above.
• LoJack by Spireon’s Privacy Policy: http://www.spireon.com/privacy-policy/
• LoJack by Spireon’s Terms of Use: https://www.spireon.com/terms-of-use/
• Apple Terms of Sale: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/us/terms.html

bluejetty:00127718:ios.description:
Learn the fretboard. Play with confidence.
Turn guitar practice into a game with Guitar Blast. Learn where notes belong, improve your recall, and build a stronger foundation for chords, scales, and improvisation.
Whether you’re learning your first notes or sharpening your skills, Guitar Blast makes fretboard practice engaging and easy to fit into your day.
LEARN THROUGH PLAY
Follow a structured campaign that introduces the fretboard step by step. Start with open strings, discover more notes as you progress, and test your knowledge with increasingly challenging levels. Find the right notes, blast them away, and aim for a better score.
TWO WAYS TO PRACTICE
Guitar Mode: Play your own guitar or bass. Guitar Blast uses your device’s microphone to recognize the notes you play and respond during the game.
Tap Mode: Practice directly on the screen. Keep learning note positions even when your instrument isn’t nearby.
FOCUS ON WHAT YOU NEED
Use Advanced Training to practice individual strings or specific sections of the fretboard. Choose your note options and session length to focus on unfamiliar areas or review what you’ve learned.
CONNECT NOTES TO MUSIC NOTATION
Staff Training helps you connect notes on the musical staff with positions on your fretboard. Strengthen your note-reading skills alongside your fretboard knowledge.
BASS GUITAR SUPPORTED
Practice on four-string or five-string bass in standard tuning. Learn bass note positions through the campaign, focus your practice with Advanced Training, and play using your bass or Tap Mode.
TUNE UP AND JAM
Get ready to practice with the built-in tuner. Then explore the Jam Room for backing tracks across rock, blues, metal, and acoustic styles, along with guitar lessons to develop your soloing and improvisation.
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Review your speed, accuracy, and scores after playing. Earn stars, unlock virtual guitar designs, and keep your routine fresh with daily challenges and streak rewards. Compare scores with other players through Game Center leaderboards.
Pick up your guitar or bass—or start tapping—and learn the fretboard one note at a time.
Standard tuning: guitar E A D G B E; four-string bass E A D G; five-string bass B E A D G. Microphone access is required for Guitar Mode and the tuner. Backing tracks and video lessons require an internet connection. Full access requires an in-app purchase.
PURCHASES AND SUBSCRIPTIONS
PRO access is available through monthly or three-month auto-renewable subscriptions, or a separate lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app before purchase. Lifetime purchases have no recurring charge.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase confirmation, or when an eligible free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings. Any free trial converts to a paid subscription unless canceled at least 24 hours before it ends.
Privacy Policy: https://ltn-games.github.io/guitarblast-privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://ltn-games.github.io/guitarblast-terms.html
Support: https://ltn-games.github.io/guitarblast-support.html
Contact: guitarblastapp@gmail.com

bluejetty:00141388:ios.description:
Шоттар, валюта және депозиттер
Мультивалюталық шот ашыңыз, қаражатты әртүрлі валютада сақтаңыз және қосымшаның өзінде басқа валютаға айырбастаңыз. Карталар, шоттар мен депозиттер бір қосымшада қолжетімді — онлайн банк қаржыны банк бөлімшесіне бармай басқаруға көмектеседі.
Депозитті ашыңыз және қажет болған жағдайда қаражаттың бір бөлігін алыңыз. Әр қаржылық міндеттеме үшін бөлек банктерді пайдалансаңыз да, Alatau City Bank-тің негізгі қызметтері бір қосымшада бола бермек.
Pay картасын ашып, бонустар алыңыз
Валюталық шоттары бар Pay картасын ашыңыз — қаражатыңызды KZT, EUR, USD және RUB-пен сақтап, басқа валютаға айырбастаңыз, сатып алу үшін 20%-ға дейін бонус алыңыз.
Банктер әдеттегі қаржылық қызметтерді бейілділік бағдарламаларымен және қосымша ұсыныстармен толықтырып жатыр, ал Alatau City Bank төлемдер, ақша аударымдары мен бонустарды бір экожүйеге біріктіруде.
Инвестициялар қосымшада
Қосымша арқылы инвестиция жасаңыз — «Alatau City Invest» АҚ-та брокерлік шотты тегін ашыңыз және толықтырыңыз, акцияларды сатып алыңыз және сатыңыз, аналитиканы алыңыз және Alatau City Bank қосымшасының «Инвестициялар» бөлімінде аналитикалық материалдармен және инвестициялық идеялармен танысыңыз. Онлайн банк күнделікті банк операцияларына ғана емес, Alatau City Bank инвестициялық мүмкіндіктеріне де қолжетімділік ұсынады.
Онлайн сақтандыру
Кеңсеге бармай және менеджерге қоңырау шалмай, бірнеше рет шертіп онлайн автосақтандыру ресімдеңіз. Сонымен қатар, қосымшада саяхаттарды сақтандыру және жазатайым оқиғалардан сақтандыру қолжетімді.
Alatau City Bank банк операцияларын, кредит беруді, сатып алуды, инвестицияларды және сақтандыруды бір қосымшада біріктіреді. Әр қаржылық міндеттеме үшін бөлек банктерді пайдалансаңыз да, Alatau City Bank-тің негізгі өнімдерін бір жерде басқаруға болады.
Бізге артқан сеніміңізді бағалаймыз. 
Барлық сұрақ бойынша 7711 нөміріне хабарласыңыз − ҚР бойынша тегін.
Счета, валюта и депозиты
Открывайте мультивалютный счет, храните средства в разных валютах и конвертируйте их прямо в приложении. Карты, счета и депозиты доступны в одном приложении — онлайн банк помогает управлять финансами без необходимости посещать отделение банка.
Открывайте депозит и при необходимости снимайте часть средств. Даже если для разных финансовых задач вы используете разные банки, основные услуги Alatau City Bank остаются под рукой в одном приложении.
Открывайте карту Pay и получайте бонусы
Откройте карту Pay с валютными счетами — держите деньги в KZT, EUR, USD и RUB, конвертируйте валюту, получайте до 20% бонусов за покупки.
Банки всё чаще дополняют привычные финансовые услуги программами лояльности и дополнительными предложениями, а Alatau City Bank объединяет платежи, переводы и бонусы в одной экосистеме.
Инвестиции в приложении
Инвестируйте через приложение — откройте и пополняйте брокерский счёт в АО «Alatau City Invest» бесплатно, покупайте и продавайте акции, получайте аналитику и знакомьтесь с аналитическими материалами и инвестиционными идеями в разделе «Инвестиции» приложения Alatau City Bank. Онлайн банк даёт доступ не только к повседневным банковским операциям, но и к инвестиционным возможностям Alatau City Bank.
Страхование онлайн
Оформляйте автострахование онлайн в три клика — без посещения офиса и звонков менеджеру. В приложении также доступны страхование путешествий и страхование от несчастных случаев.
Alatau City Bank объединяет банковские операции, кредитование, покупки, инвестиции и страхование в одном приложении. Даже если для разных задач вы используете разные банки, основными продуктами Alatau City Bank можно управлять в одном месте.
Мы ценим ваше доверие. 
По всем вопросам звоните по номеру 7711 — бесплатно по РК.

bluejetty:00071276:ios.summary: O aplicativo CNH do Brasil é a evolução da Carteira Digital de Trânsito (CDT), que começou como CNH Digital. Com o aplicativo, você acessa seus documentos digitais - Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) e Certificado de Registro e Licenci
bluejetty:00071276:ios.description:
O aplicativo CNH do Brasil é a evolução da Carteira Digital de Trânsito (CDT), que começou como CNH Digital. Com o aplicativo, você acessa seus documentos digitais - Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) e Certificado de Registro e Licenciamento de Veículo (CRLV) - de forma prática e segura, diretamente pelo celular.
Além disso, quem ainda não é habilitado pode iniciar o processo da Primeira Habilitação pelo próprio app, tornando tudo mais simples e acessível.
A CNH Digital e o CRLV Digital são as versões digitais da Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) e do Certificado de Registro e Licenciamento de Veículo (CRLV) com o mesmo valor jurídico das respectivas versões impressas.
As versões digitais trazem vantagens adicionais que propiciam maior mobilidade, praticidade e comodidade por meio de:
- Facilidade no compartilhamento das informações (exportação para PDF com assinatura digital no padrão da ICP-Brasil com validade legal conforme MP 2.200-2/2001). Isto evita a impressão e/ou digitalização de documentos, bem como dispensa a autenticação cartorial;
- Ter sua autenticidade, confiabilidade e integridade validada facilmente através do aplicativo Vio. Para isso, basta baixar o app Vio e apontar o leitor para o QR Code do seu documento digital.
Para mais informações acesse:
Perguntas frequentes:
https://portalservicos.senatran.serpro.gov.br/#/ajuda/faq/cnh-do-brasil

bluejetty:00080568:ios.description:
Set Sail! From the smallest Satoshi to a full Bitcoin—no technical expertise required. Join us and embark on a new journey into the blockchain world.
Why rely on expensive hardware or worry about complex technical terms? With our cloud solution, you can easily start your Bitcoin mining journey.
No mining on your phone. We do not use your device for mining—our remote servers handle the computing power. Simply choose the cloud mining configuration you want, and watch your Bitcoin balance grow in your built-in wallet. You can even start with our free cloud mining option to easily experience the mining process.
Experience the Cutting Edge of the Digital World
Say goodbye to cumbersome Proof-of-Work (PoW) algorithms, high electricity costs, and complex hardware setups. Our platform handles core processes like network difficulty, Bitcoin halving, and mining pool management, allowing you to focus on expanding your digital assets.
With cloud GPUs and ASICs, there’s no need to install or maintain equipment locally. Your earnings will be securely stored in your built-in Bitcoin wallet, and when you’re ready, you can easily transfer them to a personal wallet, exchange, or other Bitcoin-compatible addresses.
Key Features
 1 On-Demand Bitcoin Cloud Mining Choose the mining power you need, and we will activate the appropriate cloud GPU or ASIC to help you continuously earn Bitcoin. We adjust dynamically based on network computing power, Bitcoin prices, and hardware availability to provide a mining experience that aligns with market trends.
 2 Intuitive Cloud Platform Easily get started in just a few steps and monitor your online mining resources. Track your Bitcoin balance growth in real-time on your built-in wallet page. No professional knowledge required—just curiosity and enthusiasm for the digital age.
 3 Secure and Reliable We employ advanced encryption and robust server architecture to protect your data and transactions. Your mining earnings are fully protected while stored on the platform.
 4 Transparent Model Whether it's service fees or contract costs, we make everything clear, so you're always aware of the costs involved in the mining process—no hidden charges.
Disclaimer
 1 No Guaranteed Returns We do not guarantee a specific amount of Bitcoin, nor do we promise any fixed returns. The actual mining output you receive may fluctuate due to market conditions, network difficulty, and other uncontrollable factors.
 2 Potential Costs While you don’t need to manage hardware directly, the mining process may involve electricity, maintenance fees, and hardware wear and tear. These costs are factored into our pricing and may vary depending on the subscription plan.
 3 Market and Regulatory Risks Cryptocurrency prices are highly volatile. Past performance does not guarantee future results. You must fully understand the risks and comply with local laws and regulations regarding the legality of cloud mining. Risk is borne by you.
 4 Not Investment Advice All information provided on this platform is for educational and reference purposes only. We do not offer financial, legal, or investment advice. If you have concerns about risks or regulatory compliance, please consult a professional.
 5 User Responsibility Users must understand and comply with the laws and regulations of their jurisdiction before using this service. We are not liable for any indirect or direct losses incurred through the use of this platform.
 6 Right to Modify Services We reserve the right to adjust, modify, or terminate services (including mining configurations and fee structures) based on operational needs, market conditions, or regulatory guidelines.
This app simulates a mining experience for educational and interactive purposes. Your “mining progress” represents your participation in our rewards program, where you earn Bitcoin by completing tasks sponsored by advertisers.
Privacy Policy: https://bitcoinlucky.xyz/#/pages/privacy/index

bluejetty:00089335:ios.description:
Achieve More With No Scroll.
No Scroll is designed for professionals who want to reduce screen time, stay focused, and accomplish more.
Willpower alone isn’t enough to stop doomscrolling. You need an app that fights back.
No Scroll helps you take control of your screen time without making you delete social media.
How It Works:
1. Choose a time limit before you open TikTok, Instagram, or any app
2. No Scroll locks your app for 5 minutes when time's up
3. You scroll less, waste less time, and achieve more
Why It Works:
We built No Scroll because Apple's Screen Time and other screen time apps didn't work for us. No Scroll is built using behavioral psychology and habit design. No Scroll is easy to use and gives you the tools you need to actually stop doomscrolling.
Your time is your most valuable asset. Why waste hours doomscrolling?
Invest in yourself and download No Scroll for free today!
Features to help you scroll less:
- Session Limits: Set time limits before opening an app. Auto-locks your app when time’s up. (No Scroll’s unique feature that our users love the most!)
- Schedules: Block distracting apps during specific hours.
- App Limits: Set a daily budget for your app. No Scroll locks your app when you've reached your time limit.
- Progress Tracking: Build awareness and healthy habits.
- Minimalist design: Easy to use and distraction free.
- Privacy First: Built using Apple’s Screen Time framework to securely block apps you use. Your personal data never leaves your device.
- Built by a founder passionate about digital wellness
Try No Scroll for free today! Your future self will thank you.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/no-scroll/home

bluejetty:00153378:ios.name: Dream Space-Al Home Design App
bluejetty:00153378:ios.summary: 《Dream Space-AI Home Design App》is a smart home design application based on AI technology, which supports one-click generation of personalized house layout design, intelligent painting and replacement of items in the house, and rapid switch
bluejetty:00153378:ios.description:
《Dream Space-AI Home Design App》is a smart home design application based on AI technology, which supports one-click generation of personalized house layout design, intelligent painting and replacement of items in the house, and rapid switching of the overall style. Whether you are planning for home decoration in the early stage or collecting inspiration for daily soft furnishings, this tool can efficiently meet your design needs.
Function Introduction:
1. AI generates interior design plans for different styles and house types
Function Description: Enter the house type or select the default layout, and the AI will automatically generate a complete interior design plan that matches your style preferences, including furniture layout, color matching, and functional area division, etc. Supports the free combination of various styles (such as modern, Japanese, Nordic, new Chinese, etc.) and house types (such as bedrooms, living rooms, dining rooms, studies, etc.).
Application scenarios: It is suitable for scenarios such as style preview before home decoration, property display, and reference for interior design inspiration.
2. Apply and replace the elements of objects in the house
Function Description: By applying your fingers, you can customize and replace specific elements such as furniture, appliances, and decorations in your house. The AI will automatically recognize and generate a more harmonious new design.
Usage scenarios: It can be used to quickly replace unsatisfactory items, simulate the effect of furniture replacement, or clear away clutter to enhance the visual experience.
3. Replace the design style of the house
Function Description: Select your favorite style tags (such as minimalist, industrial, French retro, etc.), and the AI will automatically reset the furniture, walls, floors, etc. in the space, maintaining the original structure while achieving a unified update of the overall style.
Application scenarios: It is suitable for demands such as style comparison, reference for decoration decisions, and style upgrading of old Spaces.
Summarize the advantages:
1. Simple operation, no design background required
2. The effect is realistic and in line with the actual decoration logic
3. With diverse creative inspirations, it is suitable for designers, landlords, decoration users and home furnishing enthusiasts to use
Our premium features include interior design, element replacement, style transformation, and wall/floor replacement.
However, free users can also access these features by watching ads.
Premium users enjoy the following benefits:
Watermark removal
Unlimited generations
Ad-free experience
Access to all styles and features

bluejetty:00149682:ios.description:
You can access your pump data and sensor trends directly from a compatible Apple Watch. An easier and more discreet solution to help manage your diabetes, this feature is only available for the MiniMed™ 780G system. 
With the MiniMed™ Mobile app, you can view key insulin pump and CGM data right on your smartphone. This can help you better understand your glucose levels and review your history and easily see how your levels are trending. 
Automatic data uploads to CareLink™ software make sharing your data with care partners easier than ever.
IMPORTANT: This app will only work with a MiniMed™ 700-series insulin pump systems, which was specifically designed to communicate wirelessly with compatible smart devices. To find a list of compatible devices, please visit medtronicdiabetes.com/device-compatibility. The MiniMed™ Mobile app will not work with other MiniMed™ or Paradigm™ insulin pumps. To learn more about the MiniMed™ Mobile app, visit medtronicdiabetes.com. The system is for type 1 ages 7 and over. Prescription required. WARNING: Do not use SmartGuard™ feature for people who require less than 8 units or more than 250 units of insulin/day. See bit.ly/780gRisks
This app is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician, or other qualified health care provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition or treatment.
The MiniMed™ Mobile app is intended to provide a secondary display for a compatible MiniMed™ insulin pump system on a suitable consumer electronic device for passive monitoring and to sync data to CareLink™ system. The MiniMed™ Mobile app is not intended to replace the real-time display of continuous glucose monitoring or insulin pump data on the primary display device (i.e., the insulin pump). All therapy decisions should be based on the primary display device.
The MiniMed™ Mobile app is not intended to analyze or modify the continuous glucose monitoring data or insulin pump data that it receives. Nor is it intended to control any function of the connected continuous glucose monitoring system or insulin pump. The MiniMed™ Mobile app is not intended to receive information directly from the sensor or transmitter of a continuous glucose monitoring system.

bluejetty:00092691:ios.description:
Find homes for sale, discover neighborhoods, schedule showings, and make offers with Houzeo. Explore over 1.5 million properties across the U.S. and access tools to help you buy or sell your home.
Whether you're a first-time buyer, relocating to a new city, or looking for an investment property, Houzeo makes it easier to explore real estate listings and manage your next move.
FIND YOUR NEXT HOME
- Browse houses, condos, townhomes, and other properties across the U.S. 
- Search by city, state, ZIP code, or neighborhood to discover houses near you.
- Refine your house search with filters for price, bedrooms, bathrooms, and property type.
- Find any building by its name or street address and browse available homes for sale, check our reviews from residents, or assess the amenities.
- Explore new home listings and recent price reductions.
- Save favorite properties and searches for easy access.
- Invite a co-buyer to search together, browse homes, and save your favorite listings in one shared place.
- Share listings with friends and family across your favorite platforms like WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram, or grab a quick link.
EXPLORE HOMES AND NEIGHBORHOODS
- View property photos, features, and listing details.
- Discover available homes using interactive maps.
- Explore neighborhood insights and local market trends with Houzeo Neighborhoods.
- Compare the cost of living across cities.
- Calculate estimated monthly mortgage payments.
SCHEDULE SHOWINGS AND MAKE OFFERS
- Connect with real estate agents to learn more about a property.
- Schedule home showings directly from your phone.
- Make offers on homes that interest you.
- Review and counter offers online.
- Keep your home buying process organized.
NEVER MISS A LISTING UPDATE
- Get notifications about new properties and price changes.
- Save searches based on your preferences.
- Track your favorite homes.
- Stay updated on properties you're interested in.
SELL YOUR HOME
- List your property using affordable Flat Fee MLS listing plans. Starts at $399 ($0 at closing).
- Create an MLS listing to reach potential buyers and agents. 88% of buyer agents check the MLS to find suitable properties for their buyers.
- Save on traditional listing agent commissions. Home sellers have saved over $320 million using Houzeo's Flat Fee MLS service.
- Estimate your home's worth with Houzeo's home value estimator.
- Manage showing requests and offers.
- Review and counter offers online.
REAL ESTATE TOOLS IN ONE APP
Houzeo combines property search, mortgage estimates, neighborhood information, and online transaction tools to support your home buying and selling journey.
Whether you want to buy a home or sell your home, Houzeo is the real estate app that helps you explore properties, connect with agents, and manage your next steps.
Download Houzeo and start exploring properties today.

bluejetty:00167134:ios.summary:
Flyleaf is a “read-later” app that displays saved articles from the web in a meticulously designed reading view, without popups, ads or other distractions.
SAVE ARTICLES FROM THE WEB
Use the share sheet from anywhere to save interesting li
bluejetty:00167134:ios.description:
Flyleaf is a “read-later” app that displays saved articles from the web in a meticulously designed reading view, without popups, ads or other distractions.
SAVE ARTICLES FROM THE WEB
Use the share sheet from anywhere to save interesting links to Flyleaf. There is also an easy-to-use bookmarklet if you need it.
READ LATER WITHOUT DISTRACTIONS
Flyleaf takes web pages and removes everything inessential, like popups, ads and trackers, to preserve your privacy and sanity.
TURN WEBSITES INTO MAGAZINE ARTICLES
With Flyleaf's best-in-class book-like pagination, you can read articles page by page instead of scrolling vertically.
READ IT YOUR WAY
Flyleaf offers many ways to customize your reading experience, such as color themes and in-depth typography settings.
DISCOVER WHAT TO READ NEXT 
Once your list of saved articles grows, it's easy to lose track. Flyleaf helps you to always discover fresh articles from your list.
SYNC WITH ICLOUD
Flyleaf uses iCloud to securely sync articles and reading progress between your devices – no additional signups needed.
STAY ORGANIZED WITH TAGS
You can add your own tags to articles to organize your library.
READ ANYWHERE YOU GO
Enjoy fully native apps for iPhone, iPad, and macOS, lovingly crafted by indie developer Max Melzer.
READ IN FULL SCREEN 
Remove all distractions and focus on the text by entering fullscreen mode. You can still access all the controls you need through an intuitive gesture interface.
LOAD ARTICLES FROM ARCHIVE.TODAY IN ONE TAP 
Sometimes, an article may not be available in your region or without logging in. Flyleaf lets you effortlessly access many of them from a web archive instead.
AUTOMATE ACTIONS WITH SHORTCUTS AND SIRI
Flyleaf offers a comprehensive list of Shortcuts actions, so you can add URLs via Siri or build Shortcuts to automatically tag articles.
Flyleaf is free to use and offers an optional subscription for advanced features such as themes, tags and the archive.today integration.
Privacy Policy: https://flyleafapp.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://flyleafapp.com/terms/

Tawasal SuperApp is a communication platform providing free and secure calls, chats, channels, services, and more.
With Tawasal you can make high-definition video and audio calls and share photos, documents, voice messages, and more with friends and family. Tawasal Messenger provides a stable connection and perfectly works in 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G or Wi-Fi.

FREE HD AUDIO AND VIDEO CALLS: Tawasal allows you to keep your friends and family closer, even if they are overseas. Tawasal will not charge you for HD calls. Always stay in touch!
CHATS: You can send messages to your friends with unrivaled speed! Forward them, quote them, and edit them if you suddenly make a mistake.

SECURE: Always keep your information secure and private. All messages in Tawasal chats, groups, and channels are 100% encrypted with military-grade AES encryption.
SYNCED ACROSS PLATFORMS: Tawasal allows you to stay in touch no matter what device you are using. Sign in from an unlimited number of devices and continue your communication on the go.
FILES: Keep your files safe in Tawasal Cloud Storage at all times. Tawasal allows you to share any files. For example, you can send a document at work or tell a joke with an audio message.
STICKERS: We're glad to introduce our mascot - Mellow! Make your conversations more fun with Tawasal unique stickers, say "Hello" with Mellow!
FREE: There are no subscription fees or any other hidden fees for using Tawasal.
